| Hi there, Today is the 53rd anniverary of _Roe v. Wade_ , so I wanted to shed some light on why abortion clinics are being defunded across our state. The truth is, Washington Republicans like Tom Tiffany gave tax breaks to their wealthy special interests through Donald Trump’s Big Ugly Bill. [](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-jan26.E30PSJ&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_012226_B1_Abortion&t=2&akid=5786%2E196590%2ERQtD14) Now, this bill is being used to defund abortion clinics across Wisconsin — I won’t back down from fighting these dangerous policies and protecting a woman’s right to choose. [If that’s enough to convince you to join us, will you chip in whatever makes sense for you?](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-jan26.E30PSJ&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_012226_B1_Abortion&t=3&akid=5786%2E196590%2ERQtD14) These clinics provide life-saving services for so many in our state, from reproductive care to cancer screenings. body:
ICE is expanding in Colorado, and basic human rights are on the line.

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/bde7KaHH5TCapSvs72m8pg~~/AAUS1hA~/6LS-8NQsrQNeC79UaHEQtZfvJN7UAhIzQdHQZ8eLF_R6z18wnzBEF3pCiz5FGWSbnSF3gNepuWMDcR27eBzTclYY_DXxCAneWCPbA48rWO4MqPt9O-Wos2ANV76cYigd)
| | Friend, **Today, Lauren Boebert voted to give ICE even more funding.** And here in Colorado’s Fourth District, we are paying the price. Last night, I stood in **Hudson, Colorado** , alongside neighbors who are furious and afraid. Why? Because a **new ICE detention center is being built right here in CO-04.** **** A for profit private prison corporation was awarded a **39 million dollar contract** to convert a closed prison into an ICE detention facility. This is not about public safety. This is about **corporate profit and political cruelty** , backed by votes like Lauren Boebert’s. Let me be clear about something that too many politicians deliberately ignore. **Being in the country without documentation is a civil offense, not a violent crime.**
Every person, no matter where they were born, has **basic human rights**.
Every person is entitled to **due process under the Constitution**. ICE agents are supposed to follow the law.
They are supposed to obtain warrants.
They are supposed to respect constitutional limits. **They are not doing that.** Instead, ICE has become an **unaccountable paramilitary force** that is:
* Entering homes without warrants
* Using facial recognition surveillance
* Targeting workers, families, and entire communities
* Operating with near total immunity

That is not law enforcement.
That is not justice.
That is **state power without accountability**. And we already know what happens inside these detention facilities.
People are abused.
Medical care is denied.
Families are torn apart.
**A guard recently choked a detainee to death.** This is the system Lauren Boebert just voted to expand. ICE now receives **more funding than the United States Marine Corps.**
Let that sink in. I am running for Congress because **Colorado deserves better than this.** **** I will serve with integrity.
I will defend the Constitution.
I will protect due process.
And I will fight to **abolish ICE** , because an agency that refuses to follow the law has no place in a democracy. This is not about left versus right.
**This is about right versus wrong.** If you believe our communities deserve dignity.
If you believe the Constitution still matters.
If you are ready to stand up to cruelty disguised as policy. Please [**donate today**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/K0mLQ5uQQN-YkAE70xpKRw~~/AAUS1hA~/2quQYyN1gpLAFmVh_FWrTN0z5l57nUIwkFB8KtMSaT-RF4n7yRSXehhOnqK1QMhLkRQtKrgF83ckcyK9Golar7bo-_4UvmMY-C8dtGik_vFCXRRjGPdkFNT6VljBXcwUIyJXxPvie-hCnrxr3W08pKM5-DDSic3Au67OzpZhCso~) and help me take this fight to Congress. Together, we can stop this detention center.
Together, we can hold power accountable.
Together, we can choose humanity over fear. Because a new ICE detention center is being built right here in CO-04. ** A for profit private prison corporation was awarded a 39 million dollar contract to convert a closed prison into an ICE detention facility. This is not about public safety. This is about corporate profit and political cruelty , backed by votes like Lauren Boebert’s. Let me be clear about something that too many politicians deliberately ignore. Being in the country without documentation is a civil offense, not a violent crime. Every person, no matter where they were born, has basic human rights. Every person is entitled to due process under the Constitution. ICE agents are supposed to follow the law. They are supposed to obtain warrants. They are supposed to respect constitutional limits. They are not doing that. Instead, ICE has become an unaccountable paramilitary force that is: Entering homes without warrants Using facial recognition surveillance Targeting workers, families, and entire communities Operating with near total immunity That is not law enforcement. That is not justice. That is state power without accountability. And we already know what happens inside these detention facilities. People are abused. Medical care is denied. Families are torn apart. A guard recently choked a detainee to death. This is the system Lauren Boebert just voted to expand. ICE now receives more funding than the United States Marine Corps. Let that sink in. I am running for Congress because Colorado deserves better than this. I will serve with integrity. I will defend the Constitution. I will protect due process. And I will fight to abolish ICE , because an agency that refuses to follow the law has no place in a democracy. This is not about left versus right. This is about right versus wrong. If you believe our communities deserve dignity. If you believe the Constitution still matters. If you are ready to stand up to cruelty disguised as policy. Please ~ and help me take this fight to Congress. Together, we can stop this detention center. Together, we can hold power accountable. Together, we can choose humanity over fear. name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: The Stakes Go Beyond Cost of Living
body:
More Than Prices. It’s About Our Lives.

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=4ecb4ce18c&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,Across the country, people are asking the same question: _When is Washington going to get it?_ Too many leaders are consumed by political theater while ignoring what actually matters: fairness, dignity, and the future we are building together. At a moment when democracy requires courage, we are witnessing a dangerous disregard for the rule of law, and for our fellow citizens.I am running for Congress because people are tired of chaos, cruelty as strategy, and leadership that performs for headlines instead of governing with purpose. I am focused on restoring the building blocks of opportunity for working families in CA-32 and for communities across America.In conversations throughout the district, I hear the same questions again and again:
* Why has cruelty become a political strategy?
* How do we protect our civil rights and constitutional freedoms as they are stripped away?
* Why do corporations get a pass while communities pay the price?
* Why does working hard no longer guarantee stability?
* Why are immigrants, LGBTQ+ communities, and vulnerable families used as political props?

And alongside these questions are urgent, everyday realities:Groceries cost more. Rent keeps rising. Healthcare is increasingly unaffordable. Wages aren’t keeping pace, and too many families are one emergency away from financial collapse. Too often, Washington forgets the realities of people who just want to make ends meet and live with dignity. Amidst those enormous concerns, too many incumbents choose silence over leadership, including my opponent Brad Sherman.That is not acceptable.**My priorities for CA-32 are clear:**
1. Lowering costs for working families and seniors: from groceries to utilities to rent
2. Investing in good local jobs and economic growth that benefits our community
3. Protecting healthcare access
4. Restoring accountability, trust, and the rule of law in Washington

This campaign is about showing up, listening, and fighting for the people who make this district what it is. CA-32 deserves a Member of Congress who understands the pressures families are under and is prepared to build new coalitions in Congress that put people first.[**Your support helps us build a campaign rooted in affordability, stability, dignity, and opportunity.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=98e1950df7&e=53c7d12fc7)[ Join me in sending a clear message that CA-32 is ready for moral and authentic leadership, and ready to fight for it.](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=e352de3c8e&e=53c7d12fc7)

body:

[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260122-1.L6OB13&refcode=ema20260122-2718&t=1&akid=2718%2E21716%2Eg9d7l7)
Friend, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked on a heck of a lot of campaigns. Over the past 50 years, I’ve won – and I’ve lost – tough elections across the country. So believe me when I tell you:
**Sherrod Brown’s Senate race in Ohio is SO DAMN IMPORTANT, and the only way he can win it is with YOUR support – right here, right now.**
[**Please chip in every dollar you can spare to Sherrod and Sarah McBride's campaign. He just got back in the fight, and they need folks like you by his side ASAP.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260122-1.L6OB13&refcode=em20260122-2718&t=2&akid=2718%2E21716%2Eg9d7l7)
We’re at a critical moment in American history. It’s like nothing I’ve ever seen before. Politicians in D.C. are raising costs, cutting veterans' benefits, closing rural hospitals, adding $3 trillion to our national debt – the list goes on.
We’re moving further and further away from being anything close to democracy. It’s freakin’ absurd!
_We have to get our country back on track – and that starts by helping Sherrod Brown win in Ohio._
Sherrod has spent his life fighting for workers and families, and he’s got the moral courage to stand up to the powerful special interests that are making life harder and more expensive for everyday people.
**But outside spending groups will pour an UNGODLY amount of money into this race to defeat Sherrod (I’m talking hundreds of millions of dollars) – and it’s on us to give him the resources to fight back and win.**
[**Folks, if anyone can flip Ohio’s Senate seat, it’s Sherrod Brown. But he can’t do it alone – nobody can: Will you chip in $5 or even $25 right now, split between Sherrod Brown and Sarah McBride to power his campaign forward and send him to the Senate?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260122-1.L6OB13&refcode=em20260122-2718&t=3&akid=2718%2E21716%2Eg9d7l7)

Now, all across Alaska, we have scarcity.
Multi-national companies are trawling our waters and decimating our fish stocks. The moose, caribou, and migratory birds that used to fill our freezers are harder to find.
So we buy more groceries, where the prices are just _crushing_ Alaska families.
And I've got to tell you, DC people do not care that we are paying 17 bucks for a gallon of milk. _They don’t even believe us._
They're focused on their own wallets — not ours.
And when they actually work together on something, it’s usually to help themselves. The rigged system in DC is shutting down Alaska and hurting all of us while politicians and their millionaire and billionaire donors feather their own nest.
It’s why our prices are rising, and our heating bills keep going up. All while the health care and services Alaskans rely on get gutted.
I'm done with politicians getting richer while things get tougher here at home.
Systemic change is the only way to bring down grocery costs, save our fisheries, lower energy prices, and build new housing Alaskans can actually afford.
Systemic change is the only way to fill our homes with abundance again.
My agenda for Alaska will always be: fish, family, freedom. These values have been the core values of my campaigns since the very beginning.
But if we’re going to secure Alaska’s future, we need another priority: fighting corruption.

subject: A lesson Donald Trump needs to learn
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
#

Hey Peter, it’s Martin Sheen.
You may know me from my roles as an actor — _including a former fictional president_ — but tonight I’m reaching out as an American concerned about the direction our nation is heading.
My character in the West Wing famously said, “I’m the President of the United States, not the president of the people who agree with me.”
_And I think that’s a lesson Donald Trump needs to learn._
As he dismantles checks on his power and purges the government of dissenters, Americans are becoming more and more afraid to speak up and use their constitutionally protected rights to fight back against this administration.
**It’s downright scary and un-American.** The health of our democracy relies on spirited debate and freedom of speech, and we’re seeing this tradition slowly disappear.
In the midst of this chaos, one thing has become clear: We need leaders to reject this turn towards authoritarianism and stand up against Trump.
And right now — as Republicans maintain their hold on Congress and the White House — the only way we can stop the descent to one-man rule is to win in the midterms.
And no one is facing a tougher race than Jon Ossoff in Georgia this year.
Jon is the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Donald Trump won in 2024 and is the GOP’s top target for defeat. He’s a champion for the people of Georgia and a watchdog for corruption.
**He’s exactly the kind of leader we need at a time like this.**
[**That’s why I’m asking you to join me in supporting Jon Ossoff’s reelection campaign today. Will you donate $5 right now so he can win in November and continue fighting for our democracy in the Senate?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jan26.wPRyEn&refcode=em260122-2-f&t=1&akid=1490%2E5691347%2EAXqkVw)

Martin Sheen

subject: He stormed a church. A legal expert says it's a crime!
body:

| | | | | |
Two storms to chat about this week — one in Minneapolis, one heading for New Mexico.
Don Lemon went into a church during Sunday worship with cameras rolling. Kids were in the pews. The music was playing. And protesters started screaming at parishioners. The pastor tried to create space. ["We're here to worship Jesus. That's the hope of the world."](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d5e1685b96&e=567664f14c)
Don Lemon's defense? "There's a constitution and First Amendment freedom of speech." A CNN legal expert says he's wrong. She says it's a federal crime.
We play the clips and break down the law. Plus Mark's full storm forecast for the weekend.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=490da0f27c&e=567664f14c)
| |

⛪ **THEN HE PLAYED THE VICTIM**
After it was over, Don Lemon went on a podcast with Jennifer Welch. She called the parishioners "white supremacists." Don Lemon said he couldn't understand why he became the face of this story.
His producer's answer? "Don, you're a gay Black man in America."
That's not why, Don. You're the face of it because you walked into a church with cameras and filmed while protesters screamed at families during worship. We play the clip — you need to see his face when he says it.

Storm's coming and Mark breaks down the full forecast — timing, snow totals, and where I-40 gets dangerous.

Get where you need to go by Friday.

📉 **DEMOCRATS HIT HISTORIC LOWS**
Harry Enten on CNN: "Democrats in the minds of the American public are lower than the Dead Sea."
Net approval is -55 points overall and -61 with independents. That's the lowest ever recorded. This is what happens when you defend storming churches and your leaders stay silent.

🇪🇺 **TRUMP TELLS EUROPE THE TRUTH**
At Davos, the Belgian Prime Minister bragged about how Europe "speaks softly."
Trump's response: "Without us right now, you'd all be speaking German."
Mark's take: This is Colonel Jessup from A Few Good Men — "You sleep under the blanket of freedom which I provide." We play both clips.

🇬🇱 **GREENLAND — FRAMEWORK ANNOUNCED**
Trump announced a framework deal for Greenland. No tariffs on Europe. No military action.
NATO chief Mark Rutte: "President Trump is right. We need to defend the Arctic."
Crisis averted. Negotiations worked.

As a result, Trump stalled decades of public infrastructure work and wasted hundreds of millions of dollars already spent, all while threatening water systems our region depends on. name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: A leap of faith
body:
Peter,

I know you’ve heard a lot from me since we launched this campaign last
fall, and there’s a good reason for that. We’re up against Greg Abbott’s
$100 million+ warchest and the corporate backers who are bankrolling his
campaign.

I believe that the grassroots can be stronger than the billionaires and
special interests. I’ve seen it in action many times. But like I’ve said
before: A leap of faith only works if you take it. And we all have to take
this leap of faith together.

Unlike Greg Abbott, I won’t be a governor who owes favors to my wealthiest
supporters. I’m funded by the working people of Texas — and I’m honored to
have so many of you standing with me.

I’ll be honest, I don’t enjoy asking for money. But grassroots fundraising
is the way we can keep up — and win.

Corrupt leaders like Abbott have been failing our state for decades. But I
know we can turn things around with leadership that focuses on making
Texans’ lives better, not dragging us into endless culture wars and
serving the elites at our expense.

If you’re with me, I need you to show your support one last time before
midnight. We can reach our $100,000 pre-primary fundraising goal. In fact,
we’re so close that I believe we can get there in the next hour if we dig
deep and do it together.

Peter, we need to
close the gap before the clock strikes midnight. Can I count on your
support to meet this fundraising goal before the deadline?

[ https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260122_3_plain.2TpSDK&refcode=em20260122-465&amount=3&t=1001&akid=465%2E299639%2Em3sQeH ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_gh_20260122_3_plain?refcode=em20260122-465

Thank you so much for everything you’re doing.

— Gina

body:
#
_**Content warning:** this email discusses online harassment via digital forgeries of pornography._
While the images in digital forgeries may be fake, the harm they cause is very real.
Victims of nonconsensual AI deepfake pornography have lost jobs, reputations, and some have lost their lives.
Last week, the Senate unanimously passed Alexandria’s **D** isrupt **E** xplicit **F** orged **I** mages and **N** on-**C** onsensual **E** dits (DEFIANCE) Act. If passed into law, the DEFIANCE Act would give the victims of deepfake pornography the right to sue those who created or distributed the images.
**The fight for justice for these survivors will now continue in the House**.
Today, Alexandria was joined by other members of Congress and advocates to tell Speaker Johnson and the House GOP: **we are morally obligated to protect people’s bodies, reputations, and sense of safety from this technology**.
Just two weeks ago, reports surfaced that Grok — the AI chatbot on X (formerly Twitter) — is producing 1 nonconsensual, sexualized image per minute.1
In fact, digital forgeries are now so commonplace that 1 in 8 minors personally know someone who has been the victim of deepfake pornography.
Congress has passed the Take It Down Act, which requires platforms to remove sexually explicit content within 48 hours of reporting, but **there is more work to be done — we must give victims recourse and restitution**.
The DEFIANCE Act would amend the Violence Against Women Act, and has been endorsed by more than 20 organizations, including the National Women’s Law Center, the National Domestic Violence Hotline, and the Sexual Violence Prevention Association.
We will keep you posted on updates about this legislation. Thank you for standing with us.
In solidarity,
Team AOC
[Alexandria has been the target of disturbing online harassment for years, but isn’t afraid to hold those causing harm to account. Will you contribute $5 today to power her campaign for progress? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260122.RA-Xjx&refcode=em20260122-10631-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10631%2E2526796%2ErTk3QS)

clean_body: I want you to hear directly from me, Fellow American. I am running for Governor of Iowa. | Fellow American, I am not a career politician. But that’s what makes me perfect for this job. My name is Adam Steen, and I am running to be the next Governor of Iowa. We need strong leaders who are willing to roll up their sleeves. We need someone who isn’t just all talk and no action. I built businesses from the ground up. I know what it takes to win in the business world. Now, I am running for governor to apply that same work ethic. When I was appointed by Governor Reynolds as Director of DAS, I aggressively cut government waste by streamlining 37 agencies down to 16—slashing bureaucracy to save Iowa taxpayers millions. I want you to hear directly from me why I am running, and why I hope I earn your support. I am willing to fight and be bold to keep our future bright, but I need people like you in this movement. # ALMA ADAMS RECENT NEWSLETTER MISSES THE MARK AGAIN
---
| |
---
| | My friend, As we look ahead to the 2026 election, it's clear that the people of Charlotte deserve better representation in Congress than what we've had for far too long. Rep. Alma Adams has represented this district for over a decade, yet her recent actions and priorities show she's more focused than ever on partisan Washington games than on the real needs of hardworking families here at home. Just last week, Rep. Adams joined dozens of House Democrats in introducing articles of impeachment against DHS Secretary Kristi Noem, a dedicated leader working to secure our borders and enforce our laws after years of chaos under open-border policies. This move isn't about accountability; it's a politically motivated distraction that undermines national security when we need strength and focus at the Department of Homeland Security. Meanwhile, Adams blames "red tape" for delays in Hurricane Helene recovery aid while ignoring the need for efficient, accountable federal support that puts North Carolinians first. Her newsletter highlights niche bills like pushing plant-based school lunches through grants that could limit choices and raise costs for our schools, defending an overreaching Department of Education against needed reforms, and other progressive priorities that often feel disconnected from the everyday struggles in our district: rising crime, skyrocketing costs, failing schools, and a lack of real opportunity. The 12th District needs a representative who fights for common-sense solutions: safer streets, lower costs, school choice, secure borders, and putting American citizens and families first—not more federal mandates, virtue-signaling, or attacks on effective conservative leadership. Here's why I'm the right Republican to take on and defeat Alma Adams:
* Public Safety First: Crime affects every neighborhood in our district. I'll prioritize law enforcement, support our police, address repeat offenders, and launch real community-based solutions to restore peace of mind. Unlike Adams, I won't sideline safety for partisan agendas.
* Lowering Costs and Building Opportunity: Families are struggling with housing affordability and high living expenses. I'll fight for fiscal responsibility, energy independence, and job-creating policies in trades, technology, and beyond—ensuring our kids have the skills for better-paying careers.
* Education Reform: As a father and someone who values strong families, I'll champion school choice, early childhood literacy, local control over federal bureaucracy, and accountability so every child—especially in underserved communities—gets a fair shot.
* Border Security and America First: I'll stand with leaders like Secretary Noem to secure our borders, protect our communities, and ensure elections are fair (like supporting the SAVE Act so only citizens vote).
* Proven Conservative Commitment: I've signed the U.S. Term Limits pledge, earned endorsements from groups like Log Cabin Republicans, and built coalitions to bring conservative voices—including Black conservatives—into the fight for better representation.

This isn't about just about left vs. right, it's about right vs. wrong for our district. Rep. Adams has had her chance, but too many families still feel unsafe, costs keep rising, and opportunity feels out of reach. It's time for fresh, accountable leadership that delivers real results. I'm asking for your support as we approach the March 3, 2026, Republican primary. Join Team Ali—volunteer, donate, spread the word, and help us build a stronger, safer, more prosperous 12th District. Together, we can make America better for all, starting right here at home. For our families, our future, and our values, Addul Ali

Friend,

Across the country, we face a critical moment.

**School choice is under attack.**

Well-funded activists are working overtime to block families from accessing better educational opportunities for their children. They are counting on Americans to stay silent.

**The Goldwater Institute refuses to back down.**

We led the fight to bring school choice to Arizona, proving that when parents are empowered, children thrive.

Now, during **School Choice Week** , we’re taking that fight nationwide.

Too many students remain in schools that don't meet their needs. Their futures shouldn’t depend on a ZIP code or a broken system. That’s why the Goldwater Institute is fighting for school choice in all 50 states, and we won’t stop until every family has real options.

That’s where you come in.

Together, we can push back against the activists who want to keep families trapped and give parents the freedom to choose what’s best for their children.

At the Goldwater Institute, we’re not just fighting in Arizona but across the country. We have helped pass school choice legislation in more than 20 states, and we’re not slowing down.

**For nearly 40 years, the Goldwater Institute has secured high-impact victories that defend parental rights, expand school choice, and fight DEI radicalism, such as:**
* Helping parents uncover hidden DEI training materials that show teachers how to turn our kids against America
* Striking down unconstitutional policies that blatantly discriminate based on race
* Defending families when taxpayer-funded bureaucrats try to bully, silence, and intimidate them
* Eliminating DEI hiring quotas in multiple states
* Passing laws in statehouses that protect parental rights and equal opportunity

**But this fight is far from over.**

Across America, taxpayer dollars continue to fund bloated bureaucracy rather than helping students learn and grow.

**EVERY** child deserves access to the tools they **NEED** to succeed and a real education that prepares them for the future.

Parents should be free to focus on improving their children’s education, not on navigating an ever-changing bureaucratic nightmare.

The opposition remains loud, organized, and determined to challenge progress. That is why your support at this moment is critical. Each legal case, policy improvement, and success we achieve relies on supporters like you.

name: Dave McCormick
subject: How an early morning church service strengthened my faith
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dave McCormick
body:
This is a deeply personal story

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zoknj3ltg7jana9k5tibduetflvd9in6j46ff058_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shjm0pb6clh2bs)
---
| | I want to take a moment today to share a personal story with you, Friend
It’s a story about how an early morning church service and a sermon referencing Psalm 121 left an imprint on my soul and strengthened my faith.
When I arrived at West Point as a new cadet, I had no idea how much it would transform my life.
During my first plebe summer, I attended an early morning church service. The sermon referenced Psalm 121:
**“I lift my eyes to the mountains- where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.” Psalm 121**
**That psalm and my time at West Point have been a touchstone ever since, sustaining me during difficult moments in my life.**
When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I made a promise to come to Washington and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up business as usual. Now I’m working to fulfill that promise every single day.
We need leaders in DC with the strength, the will, and the moral clarity to meet the challenges we face. **So, if you’re looking to continue the status quo, I’m not your guy.**
But if you want to help me continue my fight to change the way things are done in DC, I need your support. Our average online donation is $21.38, and **_[I would be so grateful if you would generously give that amount today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp93pba8ujruak182g312qcdfunqnm1i23t2cft8_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shjm0pb6clh2bs)_**
I’m no stranger to fighting for what is right, and ****if we don’t continue pushing every single day to clean up the mess the career politicians made, we will lose America as we know it!****
There are too many pressing issues we must solve to hold back now. Whether it’s illegal immigration and the fentanyl crisis or inflation and the cost of living, we cannot afford to lose ground.
Here’s where I need your help, Friend I hate asking for money — I’m not a career politician, and it’s not in my nature — but I have no choice but to ask if we’re going to continue fighting to advance our cause to change how things are done.
Democrats from all over the country are panicking and pulling out all the stops to attack Republicans who are shaking up Washington. That’s why I’m hoping you can spare **_[$25, $50, or even $100 to help me fight back.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zabidaskq17trqckqohtf4mddeop7kr9k3h3csio_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shjm0pb6clh2bs)_**
---
[DONATE](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zleeinmiko8a7tjle1jq47klcbs01vbc1ibsltrg_rp22sh2s8i6eor4shjm0pb6clh2bs)
| | Please, join me today to fix our broken government and save what makes America worth fighting for.
Thank you,Senator Dave McCormickArmy Veteran, USMA'87
---

---
| | I'm Dave McCormick. I'm a West Point grad, combat veteran who served in the 82nd Airborne, a 7th-generation Pennsylvanian, **and last November I defeated an entrenched career politician in the #1 swing state of the 2024 election.**
I’ve seen firsthand what great leadership looks like. I’ve seen that even on our worst days, you have to put the needs of others first.
That’s why I made a promise to come to the Senate and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up Washington, and I’m working to do that every single day.
Whether it’s securing the border, reducing crime in our cities, ending the fentanyl epidemic, or bringing down the cost of living–**I’m committed to delivering concrete solutions to the biggest issues we face.**
But in order to get the job done, it’s going to take all hands on deck. I need every freedom-loving American to help me shake up Washington. I promise I won't let you down.
_Senator Dave McCormick_

## FCC Says Talk Shows Must Offer Equal Time
The Federal Communications Commission warned TV broadcasters Wednesday that [daytime and late-night talk shows](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL0SmzAQhJ8GOjH6xxQq0tA5bUrmLB1wiZAcOJvx22fwK6S7ubvZ3W9_3ac7UKay_IQNA891KngeGZlxn_DvCzLThvsrYwSOK5WFV5wnLbUXUgltpgSUP5NtU5gRNZoWg-r9oLw3vWrXAH42VkV44GCddYP0EuzNxz6pG-jetBQuNam0UUp6OXReOQvDjNY5dxvi0FiJibju3e9K5fLPn_rGvYt1a3NYmZ9HY340emz0eJ5nVx7xorjujR6fNRNTPBo9YsbIVMs1zzGKDIyi0LKySPC5SAVD_iOOtZ6H-OKL7zZCSZSubyqM-5vwPMQeC2jnjHLtHtLzpJzp8H1j5bIB5W88_q9O30H_CwAA__8XKI0p) must give equal time to opposing political candidates, reversing a 2006 decision that exempted shows like _The Tonight Show_ from such requirements. The agency said it has not been presented with evidence that current late-night or daytime talk show interviews qualify for a newscast exemption, adding that [programs motivated by partisan purposes](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2u1DAQBeCncbpZ-Se_RYpFKAXo0iBEGfna42TAsYMze8O-Pcq-At1II52j8_18m98sRUrLN7vhyCHPCc8jIjOWGf88bGTasDwiOstupbTwimHWUrcgFWgze0vxOdeVHwOiRlPhqLp2UG1rOlWto-576aW2A76bYWic9arXSpmuscGE0Fc0XmlSaaOUbOVwa1VT2yFg3TRNP7hB1BI9cS63X5nS1R-f-QPLzeWtiuPKvB_C3IWehJ7O87xtR7p-Qk-Y4HEIPV2jhJ72HInJXWdwDqJlhETLynCs-YTNPiFlhncE_IvbzhBK3uDFAJcDhFwg73s-KC3gbPLkLeOVZwvc7-rH199fdmGm7MgL8_nTBYvn8R3LXpXR7yfFSEfbiVoum6X4msD_5f4x6n8BAAD__yL-mP0) would not be entitled to an exemption. Hard-news TV newscasts don't have to offer equal time. FCC Chair Brendan Carr said networks have assumed their talk shows qualify as genuine news programs even when motivated by purely partisan political purposes. The decision means shows such as ABC's _The View_ or Stephen Colbert's _The Late Show_ could be required to provide equal opportunities if requested.
## Trump Sues JPMorgan for $5 Billion
President Trump filed a [$5 billion lawsuit](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ynDAMhZ_GdN6xBRgoKNK4u2lTMl5bsNr4hxhxmX37DHmFdF-h0XfO-fW1fDmKlLefLuHMa1kyXkdEZqwL_jldZEpYz4jesX9R3viF6wIKjFRaQrsER_GzdE2YV0TAtsFZD2bSxrSDbl7zoACh96PpwE1rixr68WmePnSjHpUPDc33N6Wh1VoZNT2M7js3rdj1fT9OfhKdwkBc6uNdKN_--CnfWB--pCbOL-b9EO0PAVaAva7rcR6OS3Cf-0CAPbjUjwB7NxNg9xKJyd94iwVYpW8GAZbrmXYZ3XWcxPK9y1Tq5rJ8u0QoA6WSZcCny78pb3KNpVJw0pezsgA7jq1qVdcrNQiwTZ3DflGMdJhBdGpLjuK_zPxfQ3_P8DcAAP__kSmQSw) Thursday against JPMorgan Chase and CEO Jamie Dimon, alleging the bank closed his accounts in February 2021 for political reasons after the Jan. 6 events at the Capitol. The lawsuit filed in Florida state court accuses the bank of [acting on "woke beliefs"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuOtCAYhq9GOwwgHigo_sZu_nZLg_Cp3ywHF3DM3P3Grbbf7k2e5D19POaHRodh-689qLLGOcCVHZQCaYavU7uCHtLpwOhidgxb2WGdOeU9oYzwdrYa3XsWtVUrAIe2BsWGXrK-bwdW72pZhKR8HZdhoNKsAN0oRiqYhEVIo9sa1e1GGW8Zoz2VTc86oeUKouu6URpZCQoWS0zNM2K48907viA1Jvraqb2UI1ftv4pPFZ-u62rCYu4VN6_4tJwZA-T8S5IbV3wq6fQHySdk8jx8TJsO5Kk9ArHoYyDaOdjAEguLDp8YNpJM0LzrhKB1Uva40DnM_VAJunmN7qdS-dOPL8W_AwAA__8HPYkb) to distance itself from Trump's conservative political views, causing considerable financial harm and forcing him into less favorable arrangements with other institutions. JPMorgan responded that the suit has no merit, stating the bank [does not close accounts](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uhDAUhE9jOiPbGLMULtLQbdqU6K39gLfxDwGzaG8fkSukG2mk-TTf1328AwVK8ydEtGXKY8JzD1gKbiP-HBAKRdyOgA6KWyjNZcFpVEIZLiRXzeiBwnvUlbcTosKmQis700tjmk5Wi711UrtGNA8EfUMDrfBGo3S-64yf5FSRvdaEVI2Uwoi-NrLV0E-o27a99a5nWqCnkrf6mSld_PDOL9xql2MV7FLKurPmg6mBqeE8z9o99uvF1TM1XJGpoWxHXPl-4M6fK495myFxt8CO_AmRkHuKOfE1ByrkIHCPD0jflGamhmqzfj0pBNpNx7SYI1D445d_SXtZ9RsAAP__JHKCig) for political or religious reasons but rather for legal or regulatory risk.
## Spain Finds Sought-After Missing Dog
A missing dog named Boro, who captivated Spain after he was caught up in that nation's deadly train crash on Sunday, was found Thursday, four days after he [bolted from the wreckage](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD0OnDAQhU8D3ayw-S9cpKHbtCnRwIxhImMT2wva20fkCmnfk97P9-s9v1Gc-O0nHmyyDbPnOznOmePMfz7oshwcP45XzOsufss721lXuoNKga5nQnHfuSnJWGbNdclG9d2ouq7uVbkbNfS4aOpxGVRL1I-0jB0hWTs2OAx1KeZJq5Sulaq6anx1qm1wtNy0bTuM61g0FZPkEF-_g_in333DxfG1hqN0Zs_5TEX9o9BToaf7vl_rkhr9uIWenjuPzBKp0BOekD7xkitECBbSieIT5IjiYY2YdjgdIyWwIcLO7gQrnsRvsHMEChssIQZAT5DCKujgYBKET-KYIKJz30JPZTR03uKcpK4vmmo7UNy_ufm_GF9G_w0AAP__2ZaTgQ) that killed at least 45 people. Owner Ana García and her pregnant sister were traveling with Boro from Malaga to Madrid when their high-speed train derailed and collided with an oncoming train. Rescue crews helped the sisters from the tilted car, but Boro ran before they could catch him. A limping García made a desperate plea: _"Please, if you can help, look for the animals."_ Thousands shared photos of the dog on social media, and Spanish [social media outlets covered the search](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSmzAQhJ9GdPJIJ1mYQkUaqjhNipTMgQ64jECOJOMhT58hr_DXO7O73_frOTyRI-_LD9zI1zkNO31KpFopD_TnjbHyRvkdacI6rbwvdaV5AAVOKi3BDAE5noNtgp-JgExDXreu086ZVjerBxsMjmYeRySLD1RqfLR2QkctgVHQsL_alAajtXKquzl9t9jNZO_3-6ObOmEVBa4p334n3q_9eKaD8m1KWxP9WuurCPNNQC-gx3G6CG5LumIB_XeeqdQzkoD-w5l-1pRPAX1JE2OUGwVGuaWRI_8lOfMe5JhykiEtsrzzwQcFWV7Ie5EaOquhc6rJPrw-HCMX1wqrlg05_v9TvyTx8PAvAAD__1PEh1s). Thursday morning, forest firefighters posted images showing García embracing Boro, one leg in a brace. _"Many thanks to all of Spain,"_ she told reporters with a smile. [See Boro here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwzAQg5_G3hzcyZJsDRq6ZEvXjoYine0r5J_KlwR5-8J9hS4ECAL8QH7dhlvgzOv0GRbyMm7DSq8jkwiVgX4eIQsvVB6ZYpA48zrJTOOgQNkGsFHtkALn96Dr5EciRW1NHjvr0Nq2w3r2UQE6F5MeO7AQIBoNLoCKsb1Ha1zN_mwDVC0iWHAXi0YHN5I2xvQuukoDJZatXL43Xk9-fm9PKpe4LXX2s8h-VO1Hpa6Vuob9HHBGpynCMVOlrsceeG2knBpLOOYmb4c0aZsaY9Cp3mKPXdJ3jMn1yibdGx1AY6_r4tP-4pz5sF2lYVoC5z-2_Ouwp1e_AQAA__-7Jnw4).

| Letter from the Chair

Join Us in Lincoln: Honoring Our Senators with Laughter & Tom Shillue!
Dear Fellow Republicans,
The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is excited to host our annual Senator Recognition Dinner on Wednesday, March 5th in Lincoln--a special evening dedicated to thanking and honoring our hardworking Republican Senators and giving them a well-deserved night of fun and relaxation away from the demands of public service.
This year, we're thrilled to welcome nationally acclaimed comedian, actor, author, and talk-show host Tom Shillue as our keynote speaker. Known for his sharp, clean humor and appearances on Gutfeld!, Fox News Saturday Night, and his bestselling book Mean Dads for a Better America, Tom brings the perfect blend of wit and warmth to lighten the mood and celebrate the people who serve our state so tirelessly.
Our Senators pour their hearts into their work--not just during the legislative session, but year-round. They prepare legislation, attend hearings, connect with constituents, volunteer in their communities, and often balance "real" jobs on top of it all. They give up precious family time and personal pursuits, all to make Nebraska stronger... and for an annual salary of just $12,000.
But as the moral virtue of eutrapelia reminds us--or "right recreation"--true balance includes refreshing the mind and spirit through humor and good company. All work and no play isn't sustainable; it's why events like this matter. A night of laughter and appreciation recharges our leaders so they can continue fighting for our values with renewed energy.
We invite you to join us! Reserve your seats today for the dinner and the exclusive VIP reception honoring those Senators whose terms conclude in 2026. Your presence will mean the world to them--and help create lasting memories.
Can't attend? Consider becoming a sponsor or making a donation. Every dollar raised supports our critical Get-Out-The-Vote efforts and volunteer recruitment for the upcoming elections--fueling the work that keeps Nebraska red and strong.
Let's show our gratitude, share some laughs, and recharge together.
Reserve your spot or sponsor now: [https://secure.anedot.com/negop/senatorsrecognition2026](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XXp5XW5oyV6UmJabnk4XmyWhq72IkLL71vS-SaM22kFIN_IM31USkkPgRGwppzoK6gbpo2CXQCuiw3lDPbac2mvvP2e6a_U9YcFTdEdQxuyHpPMbl7vp3nejqZSuvuSH_dWFs4EgYHTBNmXDEgrNmDqoi8vxg8YMzWJmrv5_jVYmY5KFMwtDxgW6XfoA9bAyXWSP0VHu-wJbp8h-Nm59ZbO_3-zMOC0b&c=gkuK1a1RsRzsjRjAgq8ou_cIuPfyHrsyRhxWyt29c57OZXuNrmh4Cw==&ch=8YAqfWdpwtMGfWNiG-074njMRUShEUecrdPx-eWghRCD6APk_XoywQ==)

## 134 Counties Under Disaster Declaration
Gov. Greg Abbott has [issued a disaster declaration](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDEP2yAQhX8N3rDw2cZmYOjClq4drTOcY1RiIiBx8u8rLFXq3g2kp_e9-37dlhv64I_7T3yQLp8tLgedOVAplBbnM-ZCyZENmLD4eBT6YF4XECC56Dj0i0MfvsvQOL0Kp7qGdDdJ1UklR9XsWo0oJCg5ox2FsyQnK-WqJufsAPPQN17XMtFB34EQ49QKJWfltm0dFKIlYoMg50tMbdnp4m_hG9-UWhsfTdB7Kc_M-h8MDANznmcbXusa7e94BH9QTTEwucT0ZWDqedcXCzEwlc3AiK6-gYG51-YjJu5zflHmfx3wfyTwLSZ-LeG4EzoeN376o6YqpuLmuRfjrJQQEwPTJO2epw_BZzmxQdwf6MM1v_yf9LeGPwEAAP__qTyWog) for 134 Texas counties ahead of the impending winter storm, which is expected to move into the Panhandle and North Texas this evening. During a Thursday press conference, he urged Texans to prepare beforehand and stay off icy roads. "_The ERCOT grid has never been stronger_ ,” Abbott [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL9uhDAMh58GtiAT_l2GDF1uu64dkUkMRArJybjH3dtXnNSpYzf7Z-n7bH_dxhuGGNLyiRtZec55THTskUSIRx923IXYk4vIKCEnoSfu06hB9wpqpZvRY4ivsS29ncCbuiRbD72pe9N3plwtAuJF09y0ZoCmhqlpETQ2E6AbTGvKYE8Y1LqpNUA3VGD6i_HzPLUG0REVLZAPkrmSld7-Ob7yg7hyeSujXUXue9F8FPpa6OtxHFWa3HnFOT8TQlmJzyokIVZ_gl0yb-qeD2K1cPDqbVH5W3Ah5XJyxEnRU5i2s4_-l6HYJdRdp8GUbP39CDGGvR-KFpYNQ3yvKP977MPqnwAAAP__wk-Q0w), noting that more than 40,000 megawatts of capacity have been added since it nearly failed during Winter Storm Uri in 2021. Officials also touted "historic investments" in weatherization and shared that over 30 power plants now have on-site fuel storage. Utility providers have crews on standby to address localized power outages from downed lines, and TxDOT has deployed 5,000 personnel to [pre-treat roads](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFywyAMhp_G3vABNjgMDF28pWtHnzDC4UqMD3Rx8vY959on6Cjp9Enf_3WdrxBT3NZPuKOlZ8jzhkdNSIRl9rFCJSwelwQFKOaN8AnVzZJLzbhgsp89xPSah9Zbx70RLVoxaiO00cq0N-ul60c1apROKQfjolUQSizy4hAD5220J4wL2QvJuRo7bvTF-BDcYAAWxGbg6CPl0tEN3_dDeuUHlm7J9zbZG9Fem_6jkVMjp-M4usXV0-KcN3J6rzRyOlt_JVvzg60FVwbOZSJWd4TvyvLGKgEh2wvuv8qVhVzYETfCwirlckLbYv1-xJRi1WMz8PUOMb0fov_F-LDyJwAA__8flIrQ) with a brine solution. Over 280 warming centers will be available across the state. Texas Division of Emergency Management Chief Nim Kidd [urged residents](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_yoyAQx59GOxxAA0dBcY1drr3SWWTRnUHJwF5M3v4meYVf__37-Xtf7kCZzu0PHOj5lcpy4tUyMmNdIjVojDXimqECUzkZX9DCoqU2QiqhxyUC5fcy9dEHGZ3q0StrnDLO3Fy_-9XFeBsNqsmiWY2yFuVqg3F2dEFZ1ZP_hEmlR6WlvNlBOvPLxZTC5ABWxG6SGIlLHXjHb3_K7_LEOqzl6LPfmR-tG393eu70fF3XkMrLwr_GdH4knZ4_nzo9f83iopOxisalHuJC4B2rCJUw0bmJVMshtvIUEEJhFo2BUZSUaCXIra8-Pi7KmZqx3SS3Ayh_h_DP8D29_h8AAP__tmWIIg) to remember the Four Ps: Protect people, pets, pipes, and plants. "_We’re going to make it through this process_ ," Abbott said. "_The goal is to make it through with no life lost_."
## Tighter ID Proposal Criticized at DMV Hearing
Around 35 people criticized a proposal by the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles to [tighten identification requirements](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHypCAMh59GOxxAxT8FxTV2e-2VDkLUzKI4EFf37W_cra6-MvlNviTfn8fwsBhwm3_bFQxdUxw2OHMAIkiDx2wzQfLggk2WMG4El83jILlUjAsm68FbDO-hKb0ZudeiBCM6pYXSqtXlYuzUKs25lV2ruJ7qRvx0amo70TQOuOIlmhvGhayF5LztKq7Vj_bTNDbaWgdQNBw8UkwVLfDZP4V3fEGqXFzLYBaiPRf1r0L2hezP86ye1_W6w0L29zeF7D9j7J_CxWMjhMzsQZHh5o9M6c32Iy9stO7J4sb2FPeYwTP0LEGmhO6WkO_M2cQSzJjpa4YRgmc3al1x_vbKZPx-YgiYVVc0fF4ths_Z9H-yX0b-DQAA__9HlZkx) for vehicle registrations and renewals during a Wednesday public hearing at the agency's headquarters in Austin. | | Hey Peter! I hope you’re staying nice and warm this morning. 2025 was a hard year for Maryland families, but we still managed to accomplish some great things together. I co-led **2** bills that became law, sponsored **18** bills and resolutions and sponsored **23** amendments, and cosponsored **264** bills. I worked on issues ranging from health care costs to uterine cancer research to anti-corruption, economic empowerment, child care, affordable housing, voter protection, community investment, infrastructure, and more. **So, with the new year in full swing, I'm checking in to learn more about your top issues and how I can ease your burden in 2026.** I wish I could sit down with you personally, but instead my team and I figured out the next best thing: **my 2026 Priorities Survey!** Your feedback helps me decide where to focus my efforts. For instance: Many constituents expressed concerns about unaffordable housing, so I worked on several bills to lower rent prices and make it easier to buy a home. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. clean_body: | | | | | Peter, As we begin a new year, I want to sincerely****thank you for your steadfast support and commitment to Team Knott. Your belief in this mission has made a real difference, and I am deeply humbled and grateful. Over the past few weeks, I have taken time to reflect on what we were able to accomplish together this past year—and it’s something to be proud of: | | We took bold steps to secure the border , restoring enforcement and accountability where it was long overdue. That meant arresting and deporting criminal illegal migrants, prioritizing public safety, and turning up the heat on narco-terrorists, traffickers, and cartel networks that profit from chaos and human suffering. For the first time in years, the message was clear: our laws matter, and they will be enforced. We advanced the One Big, Beautiful Bill that cut through red tape, rolled back burdensome regulations, unleashed American energy and job creation, and put working families—not bureaucrats—first. It was a clear rejection of failed, big-government policies and a decisive step toward economic growth, lower costs, and renewed confidence in America’s future. Folks, that’s good progress. As I look ahead to the year before us (an election year) and chart our path to victory, both in our race and for the future of our country, it’s clear that we are facing an organized and engaged opposition. This year will be just as consequential as the last. Our majority in Congress is slim. Every seat matters. And every level of support matters if we are going to keep Congress red , stop the radical agenda from gaining any foothold, and build on our victories for North Carolina and America. | | Thank you again for believing in this mission and for standing with us. Municipal annexation in Mississippi has a dirty little secret. Too often it is less about "smart growth" and more about expanding a city's taxing and regulatory footprint. A line gets drawn on a map, a neighborhood gets swept in, and folks who never asked for city government suddenly wake up owing city taxes and living under city rules.
House Bill 4 fixes that problem the way it should be fixed in a free state. It puts the decision back in the hands of the people who have to live with it.
Right now, annexation fights tend to be decided in chancery court. Cities hire lawyers, residents try to keep up, and a judge weighs whether the annexation is "reasonable" or serves "public necessity." That process might sound objective, but it stacks the deck against ordinary citizens. Worse, it lets government growth happen without a clear, direct yes from the people being pulled into the city.
HB4 changes the basic assumption. It removes annexation approval from chancery courts and moves annexation to an election process. Here is the key protection. If 20 percent of the electors in the area targeted for annexation petition for an election, the city must hold one. Annexation cannot happen unless it wins separate majorities: a majority vote inside the city and a majority vote in the territory being annexed.
That separate approval requirement matters. Cities have built in incentives to annex. They gain more taxpayers, more revenue, and more political control. But residents outside city limits often live there on purpose. They want fewer rules, fewer fees, lower taxes, and more freedom to use their property without city hall hovering over their shoulder. HB4 respects that choice instead of treating it as an obstacle to be overcome.
The bill also blocks repeat pressure campaigns. If voters reject annexation, the city cannot just come right back the next year and try again until people are worn down. HB4 imposes a five year timeout before another annexation attempt can be made in the same area. That is simple fairness and a real check on government persistence.
To be clear, HB4 does not eliminate courts from the process entirely. It keeps court involvement primarily for municipal boundary contractions and related appeals, meaning cases where a city is shrinking rather than expanding. That is appropriate. The liberty concern is government expansion, because expansion is where new taxes and new regulations follow.
At the end of the day, annexation is about jurisdiction. It is about who gets to tax you, regulate you, and tell you what you can and cannot do with your property. That kind of power should not be expanded by default, and it should not hinge on courtroom maneuvering.
HB4 makes annexation earn legitimacy the old fashioned way. Get a clear yes from the people. If a city wants to annex an area, it should make its case and it should win the vote on both sides of the line. That is consent of the governed, applied where it counts.

clean_body: Municipal annexation in Mississippi has a dirty little secret. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? from the desk ofDana Criswell | | | Jan 23 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Photo by on Municipal annexation in Mississippi has a dirty little secret. Too often it is less about "smart growth" and more about expanding a city's taxing and regulatory footprint. A line gets drawn on a map, a neighborhood gets swept in, and folks who never asked for city government suddenly wake up owing city taxes and living under city rules. House Bill 4 fixes that problem the way it should be fixed in a free state. It puts the decision back in the hands of the people who have to live with it. Right now, annexation fights tend to be decided in chancery court. Cities hire lawyers, residents try to keep up, and a judge weighs whether the annexation is "reasonable" or serves "public necessity." That process might sound objective, but it stacks the deck against ordinary citizens. Worse, it lets government growth happen without a clear, direct yes from the people being pulled into the city. HB4 changes the basic assumption. It removes annexation approval from chancery courts and moves annexation to an election process. Here is the key protection. If 20 percent of the electors in the area targeted for annexation petition for an election, the city must hold one. Annexation cannot happen unless it wins separate majorities: a majority vote inside the city and a majority vote in the territory being annexed. That separate approval requirement matters. Cities have built in incentives to annex. They gain more taxpayers, more revenue, and more political control. But residents outside city limits often live there on purpose. They want fewer rules, fewer fees, lower taxes, and more freedom to use their property without city hall hovering over their shoulder. HB4 respects that choice instead of treating it as an obstacle to be overcome. The bill also blocks repeat pressure campaigns. If voters reject annexation, the city cannot just come right back the next year and try again until people are worn down. HB4 imposes a five year timeout before another annexation attempt can be made in the same area. That is simple fairness and a real check on government persistence. To be clear, HB4 does not eliminate courts from the process entirely. It keeps court involvement primarily for municipal boundary contractions and related appeals, meaning cases where a city is shrinking rather than expanding. That is appropriate. The liberty concern is government expansion, because expansion is where new taxes and new regulations follow. At the end of the day, annexation is about jurisdiction. It is about who gets to tax you, regulate you, and tell you what you can and cannot do with your property. That kind of power should not be expanded by default, and it should not hinge on courtroom maneuvering. HB4 makes annexation earn legitimacy the old fashioned way. Get a clear yes from the people. If a city wants to annex an area, it should make its case and it should win the vote on both sides of the line. That is consent of the governed, applied where it counts. | | Friends,
One of the best ways to measure the quality of a candidate is by looking at merit-based endorsements, endorsements from respected professionals who are willing to put their own reputations on the line because they believe a candidate is the right person for the job.
One of the first unsolicited endorsements I was humbled to receive after announcing my candidacy came from David and Steven Kallman of the Kallman Law Group.
You may recognize their names. Dave and Steve Kallman represented one of the Republican electors who was targeted and prosecuted by Dana Nessel, a case they successfully defended and that was ultimately dismissed.
While I was protecting the people of Eaton County, David and Steve Kallman were among the attorneys who were truly on the front lines during the height of the pandemic, fighting government overreach and defending parents and small businesses against unlawful actions by the state and MDHHS.
Dave and Steve Kallman are responsible for beating Gretchen Whitmer in the pivotal case in which the Michigan Supreme Court invalidated executive orders issued after April 30, 2020, for being unconstitutional.
They also fought school mask mandates imposed by MDHHS. Their affiliated organization, the Great Lakes Justice Center, brought one of the earliest cases, Resurrection School (a Lansing-area Catholic elementary school) v. MDHHS and Hertel.
They also helped concerned parents of college-aged children obtain religious exemptions for vaccine mandates in 2021. I am proud to say that my wife, Mina, an attorney, mirrored their efforts and helped other parents do the same. Our son, Nicolas, was directly affected.

clean_body: The Kallman Group are on the front lines | | | | | == | | | == | | Friends, One of the best ways to measure the quality of a candidate is by looking at merit-based endorsements, endorsements from respected professionals who are willing to put their own reputations on the line because they believe a candidate is the right person for the job. One of the first unsolicited endorsements I was humbled to receive after announcing my candidacy came from David and Steven Kallman of the Kallman Law Group. You may recognize their names. Dave and Steve Kallman represented one of the Republican electors who was targeted and prosecuted by Dana Nessel, a case they successfully defended and that was ultimately dismissed. While I was protecting the people of Eaton County, David and Steve Kallman were among the attorneys who were truly on the front lines during the height of the pandemic, fighting government overreach and defending parents and small businesses against unlawful actions by the state and MDHHS. Dave and Steve Kallman are responsible for beating Gretchen Whitmer in the pivotal case in which the Michigan Supreme Court invalidated executive orders issued after April 30, 2020, for being unconstitutional. They also fought school mask mandates imposed by MDHHS. Their affiliated organization, the Great Lakes Justice Center, brought one of the earliest cases, Resurrection School (a Lansing-area Catholic elementary school) v. MDHHS and Hertel. They also helped concerned parents of college-aged children obtain religious exemptions for vaccine mandates in 2021. name: Kim Driscoll
subject: Recapping the State of the Commonwealth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Hey Peter,
I’m feeling fired up this morning after Maura’s incredible State of the Commonwealth address last night.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mv_SjSYdDjT9OvZPauY8sZn7ehlcY5z1/view?usp=sharing [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mv_SjSYdDjT9OvZPauY8sZn7ehlcY5z1/view?usp=sharing]
In case you missed it, here are a few highlights:
☑️ Governor Healey outlined our plan to bring down energy costs, including immediate action to reduce electricity bills by 25 percent and gas bills by 10 percent for every Massachusetts residential utility customer in February and March.
☑️ She raised the bar on what we can achieve to bring down housing costs and keep residents in Massachusetts by nearly doubling the number of middle-income families who can receive homebuyer assistance through MassHousing.
☑️ Fresh off of taking nation-leading action to eliminate prior authorization for many routine and essential services, the Governor announced plans to file new regulations to ban medical debt from being reported to credit agencies.
☑️ The Governor announced that we'll meet our 2026 goal of universal Pre-K funding in all Gateway Cities. Committed to expanding educational opportunities at every age, she pledged to continue growing Early College and Career Innovation Pathways and set a new goal of registering 100,000 new apprentices in fields such as construction, health care, tech, advanced manufacturing and education in 10 years.
☑️ She announced plans to file strict new requirements to protect kids on social media, including requirements for parental consent and age verification and disabling addictive features like continuous scrolling and notifications between certain hours.
Listening to Maura last night made me prouder than ever to work alongside a leader who puts people first.
I don’t need to tell all of you what’s at stake this fall for Massachusetts and beyond. Maura and I are up against a group of MAGA-aligned self-funders who are funneling millions into their campaign coffers to beat us.
We need your help to spread our vision for a better Massachusetts from Pittsfield to Provincetown and everywhere in between. Please amplify Maura’s words by sharing the graphic included in this email across social media. You can also take it one step further by splitting a donation between our campaign and the Massachusetts Democratic Party. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mdpdriscoll2026]
Together, we’re going to ensure Massachusetts moves forward and continues to be a beacon of hope for the rest of the country to follow.
Thanks for all that you do,
Kim

name: Senator Chris Murphy
subject: We need Mallory in the U.S. Senate.
body:
[ https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/701?c0=mam-em-jan2026.QSnpyP&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_VIP_AC_20260123_AM1_V1_S1&t=1001&akid=3876%2E898137%2EdLH9Gh ][IMG]

Team — Chris
Murphy here, and today, I’m officially endorsing Mallory McMorrow for the
U.S. Senate in Michigan.

In a minute, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to her campaign
because it is so important that we win this race. But first, let me make
the case for why Mallory is the best candidate in this race, and why we
need her to win.

We are not in normal times, and we need new leaders and new voices in the
Senate who will meet the moment. Leaders who know how to fight and also
how to deliver.

Mallory knows the status quo isn’t working, and she’s already done in
Michigan what so many people want to see more of from our leaders in
Washington.

In the Michigan state senate, she took on big, powerful interests and beat
them. She delivered on the things that really matter: raising wages,
cutting taxes for Seniors and working families, holding corporations
accountable, passing sweeping gun safety laws, repealing the state’s
abortion ban, and that’s just the start.

There is no doubt that the Michigan U.S. Senate race will be one of the
closest and most expensive races in the country. Our path to taking back
the Senate requires holding Michigan, and I know that Mallory has what it
takes to win this seat.

Mallory is a proven winner. In her first election, she flipped a deep-red
seat, defeating a longtime incumbent. And she wins by building real
coalitions and connecting with voters.

But to win this race, she needs our help. Mallory is going up against a
Trump-endorsed Republican and MAGA billionaires are already pouring
millions of dollars into this race. Unlike her opponents, she doesn’t take
a dime of corporate PAC money.

But first, let me make the case for why Mallory is the best candidate in this race, and why we need her to win. We are not in normal times, and we need new leaders and new voices in the Senate who will meet the moment. Leaders who know how to fight and also how to deliver. Mallory knows the status quo isn’t working, and she’s already done in Michigan what so many people want to see more of from our leaders in Washington. In the Michigan state senate, she took on big, powerful interests and beat them. She delivered on the things that really matter: raising wages, cutting taxes for Seniors and working families, holding corporations accountable, passing sweeping gun safety laws, repealing the state’s abortion ban, and that’s just the start. subject: ICE denied me entry.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter — I recently went down to an
ICE federal facility in Minneapolis to conduct oversight as a member of
Congress and seek accountability as ICE terrorizes my community.

What happened next will not surprise you:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260123-io.gsMWK2&refcode=em20260123-37392&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37392%2E1203867%2Ekg3VCc ]Tweet by Ilhan Omar: I was just denied access to the ICE processing
center at the Whipple Building. Members of Congress have a legal right and
constitutional responsibility to conduct oversight where people are being
detained. The public deserves to know what is taking place in ICE
facilities.

This is a blatant and illegal attempt to obstruct members of Congress from
doing their job. And it’s just another example of ICE acting as a runaway,
unaccountable, secret police force operating outside of the law.

They don’t answer to Congress. They don’t answer to the Courts. They don’t
answer to state officials or law enforcement. And they certainly don’t
answer to the American people, who they have harassed, detained, beaten,
and shot at on a daily basis.

No, ICE answers only to the President. They’re a squad of personal thugs
ready to be unleashed on the President's political opponents.

Just look at how they have refused to cooperate with Minnesota on an
investigation into the murder of Renee Good. They care more about
protecting their own than seeking truth, justice, and accountability for
an American citizen who was killed in cold blood.

It’s fascism, it’s authoritarianism, and the American people cannot and
will not stand for it.

If we are to protect our democracy as we slide down this slippery slope,
it’s absolutely imperative that we meet MAGA and the far-right in every
state and every district across the country with a tidal wave of
opposition.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260123-io.gsMWK2&refcode=em20260123-37392&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=37392%2E1203867%2Ekg3VCc ]Please, split a donation between my campaign and Justice Democrats to
power our movement as we fight back here in Minneapolis and work to
protect our neighbors from ICE’s attacks.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260123-io.gsMWK2&refcode=em20260123-37392&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=37392%2E1203867%2Ekg3VCc ]Contribute $5

We all have a role to play in building the movement to end this insanity.

I will continue to do what I can, with all the power I have as a member of
Congress, to fight back. I’m counting on you to do your part too, and help
us defeat Trump’s extreme agenda and out-of-control presidency.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

#### **Kevin Ford Jr. Reports $207,270 Raised in January Filing; Demonstrating Front-Runner Strength in Maryland’s District 24 State Senate Race **
**Prince George’s County, MD** — The campaign of Kevin Ford Jr., candidate for Maryland State Senate in District 24, reported **$207,270 in total contributions** in its January campaign finance report filed with the Maryland State Board of Elections.The report reflects contributions from **more than 650 individual donors** , with **over 60 percent coming from Maryland residents** , underscoring broad grassroots support and deep local investment in Ford’s vision for District 24 and Prince George’s County.“These numbers reflect a campaign that people believe in and want to be part of,” said Richard Merritt, Campaign Manager. “Raising more than $207,000 at this point in the cycle speaks to Kevin’s record of service, the clarity of his message, and the strength and discipline of an operation that is prepared to compete and win in June.”Ford, a longtime community advocate and organizer, is running on a platform focused on public safety through prevention, stronger schools, neighborhood revitalization, and leadership that is present, accountable, and accessible. The campaign has emphasized early investment in voter contact, visibility, and grassroots organizing to build a durable path to victory.“I’m humbled by the encouragement and trust so many people have shown through their support,” Ford said. “District 24 has benefited from decades of dedicated public service. This campaign is about continuing that legacy while bringing renewed enthusiasm and accountability to the work ahead.”With the January filing complete, the campaign will continue to build its coalition by engaging residents, activating its volunteer base, and focusing on the issues that matter most to families across District 24.For more information, visit [www.kfordjr.com.](https://z6h1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=697389d6c3ec401f2f8d38c3&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.kfordjr.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D69725d73576d0e567a221cf4%26ss_email_id%3D697389d6c3ec401f2f8d38c3%26ss_campaign_name%3DThank%2Byou%2Bfor%2Bbelieving%2Bin%2Bmy%2Bcampaign%2521%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-01-23T14%253A47%253A42Z&w=67e59626f08d7b1924bf5048&c=b_69725d73576d0e567a221cf4&l=en-US&s=zgeg6MnLNNHHA7Q8_BF8OWOYmM8%3D)**Contact:

clean_body: Kevin Ford Jr. Reports $207,270 Raised in January Filing; Demonstrating Front-Runner Strength in District 24 State Senate Race | | | | | | Kevin Ford Jr. Reports $207,270 Raised in January Filing; Demonstrating Front-Runner Strength in Maryland’s District 24 State Senate Race Prince George’s County, MD — The campaign of Kevin Ford Jr., candidate for Maryland State Senate in District 24, reported $207,270 in total contributions in its January campaign finance report filed with the Maryland State Board of Elections.The report reflects contributions from more than 650 individual donors , with over 60 percent coming from Maryland residents , underscoring broad grassroots support and deep local investment in Ford’s vision for District 24 and Prince George’s County.“These numbers reflect a campaign that people believe in and want to be part of,” said Richard Merritt, Campaign Manager. “Raising more than $207,000 at this point in the cycle speaks to Kevin’s record of service, the clarity of his message, and the strength and discipline of an operation that is prepared to compete and win in June.”Ford, a longtime community advocate and organizer, is running on a platform focused on public safety through prevention, stronger schools, neighborhood revitalization, and leadership that is present, accountable, and accessible. The campaign has emphasized early investment in voter contact, visibility, and grassroots organizing to build a durable path to victory.“I’m humbled by the encouragement and trust so many people have shown through their support,” Ford said. “District 24 has benefited from decades of dedicated public service. This campaign is about continuing that legacy while bringing renewed enthusiasm and accountability to the work ahead.”With the January filing complete, the campaign will continue to build its coalition by engaging residents, activating its volunteer base, and focusing on the issues that matter most to families across District 24.For more information, visit : D. | Rudy Giuliani The Left thinks they’ve finally got me... | | Dear Patriot,
---
This is the most personal letter I’ve ever written.
---
I’m writing to you not as America’s Mayor, not as a former prosecutor, not even as President Trump’s former attorney, but as an 81-year-old man – a grandfather and a patriot – staring down a 20-year prison sentence for doing what I believed was right.
---
I’ve taken on mobsters. I’ve faced terrorists. I’ve battled corruption. I’ve been through it all.
---
_Or so I thought..._
---
**...But now, a Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
They think they’ve finally got me! Left me with no escape, no lifeline – especially after they’ve already STRIPPED me of my law licenses!
---
_No pardon.
No protection.
No cavalry coming over the hill. _
---
But even though the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
So, with my back against the wall, I’m turning to the one thing that can save me: _**the collective voices of MILLIONS of patriots like _YOU_.**_
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?)— calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.

[**Please help me reach this life-saving _(truly!)_ goal today by immediately adding your name to “THE PEOPLE’S PARDON” as citizens unite to call for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES against me.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?)

Thank you and God Bless you,

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2038%2E791427%2Esfbkgx)

Friend, Trump can attack me all he wants; I’m used to it.
But to say that Minnesota has “horrible people” really shows just how much Trump hates his fellow Americans.
**He doesn't believe in America First, only Trump First, Billionaires First, and Epstein and Pedophiles First.** He doesn’t give a damn about regular Americans, and what he’s done in Minnesota proves it.
The Minnesota I know is full of the most wonderful, welcoming people you’ll ever meet. We value kindness and hospitality. We embody “Minnesota nice” whenever we can. We respect our neighbors, even if they have a different background or worldview.
And most importantly, we look out for each other, especially now as the Trump administration sends ICE thugs to terrorize our cities and crack down on immigrants and citizens alike.
Over the last few weeks, we have seen incredible acts of selflessness and solidarity. Regular folks putting their bodies on the line to protect people they’ve never even met. Minnesotans of all ages and political parties are organizing, protesting, documenting, and giving ICE a piece of their mind.
**Trump doesn't know Minnesota,** but I do, and I know we will not back down to his fascist takeover.
[**If you’re with me, whether you live in Minnesota or anywhere else in the country, make a contribution to power our movement. Peter,
When I first ran for office in 2018, I was a young candidate running to be a Cook County Commissioner--trying to break into a political system that wasn't built for people like me.
I was offered a contribution of $56,500 from a corporate PAC.
For a first-time candidate running for a county-level seat, that is a staggering amount of money. That is the type of check that can swing an election. It's the kind of money that propels careers and secures victories.
But I didn't even have to think about it.
I refused the check.

clean_body: | | | | | == | Peter, When I first ran for office in 2018, I was a young candidate running to be a Cook County Commissioner--trying to break into a political system that wasn't built for people like me. I was offered a contribution of $56,500 from a corporate PAC. For a first-time candidate running for a county-level seat, that is a staggering amount of money. That is the type of check that can swing an election. It's the kind of money that propels careers and secures victories. But I didn't even have to think about it. I refused the check. | | == | Now, in my campaign to be the next Congresswoman for IL-9, these same special interests and corporations are back--circling this open seat like vultures, looking for any candidate willing to take their money and do their bidding in Congress. I made a choice back then to rely on people, not corporate PACs. It's a harder road, but it's the only one worth taking. Groups like AIPAC are geared to spend up to seven figures to try and buy this seat.
