[This is Michele Tafoya – I’ve got a quick story to share if you’ll indulge me for a few moments.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=05a2f73cedc94ffca8536cea08104674&_e=IJaX3wCEljAaEUCXIdWBMVDSe4tVbcUriuzBrVKbAJKstC1Eluefg1FXuPZbfSQ_piF2wyfcJSmLFRtDsloIhBQtn2mydJuUW5BoY2VubuzvdwFhuTDEH0gLPdcl2aRCxCqH7EEriKJkhNrfsCKODZ9gChgcepMoIpKouoqCgTmO0ypGAfmBgFgrh_7ZCooA68j01ucsAd4bh955kFVRdbQ6k0-7l0EOLPTjt_Eng_tW1p_D7VEseXmPy3cSMVVXdlxGc3KzkrxU_ewAQrJ3qHCB9cXtB8oA4qF0ZeSpx3rdWuiaR9bM4AuRBROJkb3wLshB70R2dPkN7xI9OrEVw-QVH152MXUfLkRg3GnFHhaDXSQRdUVMA9oiEDN50yUa0j3HPQ9qhtL2HZ703Kv6AT5S8Rhp-sWm7ExAX2NythHg3V6KEI5AUZ0aQuJ3zoR60o9VYhL1P4ZEzw1qX903lnlhHvu6YexbgFeRcPM99Nuz2ZzFiB7tvRUeLfGdI4WlYLPNcrvUSYkf5ljTzfinwtxKsXsSzjRRCiAJdEkEJzcv_nqHCz92b3O6h_fmIxabDcZVpRUjty9vDpPfKxARA-WbTrDV-gp7DBJTvIp0MvTK4hG3fJsTP_hRrqrjcWC1owVLq0lwv3UvGl95g45n__Yr19ao2PT1EgjQTHXFFia9-Wn79SyLhWQFtoqLQjbiKtk5wSvIocWjpM7sae7rN_RSQbd4ypWXAORyPWxMLYv7U9oEcfIslRo6-0eSn0K2z_RkViFcetjZsDTRa18YuLdPm2odQfONe3Tr5vuaAW4kJh-U8ySwtZZkJXQlFWpH)
Folks might've killed to have my job.
I was a sideline reporter for pro football and basketball. I covered some of the most exciting games in history. I watched sports for a living. And I loved every minute, every touchdown, and every Hail Mary.
I reached the pinnacle of my career... but there was one problem:
I had to watch what I said. I was a public-facing representative for a world-class sports network. I couldn't share everything I believed, and no one really knew I was a Conservative.
So I hung up my press badge and quit my dream job so I could speak my mind. [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=05a2f73cedc94ffca8536cea08104674&_e=IJaX3wCEljAaEUCXIdWBMVDSe4tVbcUriuzBrVKbAJKstC1Eluefg1FXuPZbfSQ_piF2wyfcJSmLFRtDsloIhBQtn2mydJuUW5BoY2VubuzvdwFhuTDEH0gLPdcl2aRCxCqH7EEriKJkhNrfsCKODZ9gChgcepMoIpKouoqCgTmO0ypGAfmBgFgrh_7ZCooA68j01ucsAd4bh955kFVRdbQ6k0-7l0EOLPTjt_Eng_tW1p_D7VEseXmPy3cSMVVXdlxGc3KzkrxU_ewAQrJ3qHCB9cXtB8oA4qF0ZeSpx3r5A7ML5Il61p24Cn44xwwwJRgBSlbdEAK75N8_ZCgnG08BbbgIrMRXUjuuiLF5zvOv33ihzbKuylFIEVAD3r4zRvWNxJAAmtSaRIwDC4hzjTBBdOcP1LDzFv7HcPidKpAB7TgbBjLZQ21N05C4XxhZndsSnTckLVThwRbUnnioTKBP9ZclTsJ2JHMTxBOBDw253Y7baBChbDE2EGoN1cYsluAyQgqJwadBz2sGkIwnm3evRZb1aJ-Lc2wBpEoQNtb6s69VgMr-t5MV4PM1ttXRZ-4d9s6YuEHqv18_5_UgVNgiQBjAjzc8aqoKcv62JP4WWP-5uodg3G9lB1vbR8XGZfs7Erir6nvUIYpisBX0KujbWTiv1xd1Zws6QlK2BIsyies28ebLTU9gkbLEQf4DVvIwIQTrZSS7HZBwKBhQEYQJBR0bnRveB4A9zL7dByVWoWn9_6gRJWGDJGuiXjQPW4EtqcUF8af4_fi9K-_F9NSZzKA8e7Ngl3Sg7Q8EzBJ2z960lk229916m_E1YE17)It was the hardest decision I've ever made. I was scared, excited, and liberated - all at the same time. **
**People said I was OUT OF MY MIND. **
**But I knew God was leading me in a certain direction, and that 's no time for half-measures. I knew he had a plan for my life. So I took a leap of faith and never looked back.**
**[Now, a few years later, I’ve started a growing podcast, campaigned for commonsense in Minnesota, and now launched a campaign for U.S. Senate!](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=05a2f73cedc94ffca8536cea08104674&_e=IJaX3wCEljAaEUCXIdWBMVDSe4tVbcUriuzBrVKbAJKstC1Eluefg1FXuPZbfSQ_piF2wyfcJSmLFRtDsloIhBQtn2mydJuUW5BoY2VubuzvdwFhuTDEH0gLPdcl2aRCxCqH7EEriKJkhNrfsCKODZ9gChgcepMoIpKouoqCgTmO0ypGAfmBgFgrh_7ZCooA68j01ucsAd4bh955kFVRdbQ6k0-7l0EOLPTjt_Eng_tW1p_D7VEseXmPy3cSMVVXdlxGc3KzkrxU_ewAQrJ3qHCB9cXtB8oA4qF0ZeSpx3pupyt3NSyFUpaYBRI9PaK61DWVMiEh_6uAmkZ7xe1id8I8EYUuzFESo6W7eTgo18lNbCHBoy7fMMbWU0sJxYAOFwMFvfQ-cJE5CyeVuUnM6398L_tuPCKcl8RDslENgvo7y0QEmXz3FqHNAA2Qk1Fw4XLDeoF17yEfthCx3Yl8GOSpRVo87_ufwONV9FjANjHwWZp7PDAFeO7dPDmkhAHAaDHV5GzpD3I0KNVUvAMvFH0y1Vbew5arbiDxowOQFRvm4rpNQqOpcfe16GubDAcyS3_mRzioSupv06dViTeqozxWos7e32HyzUTncG5deeT9e1bemFYGx5NlX2TaEkb6-b3PveJIZ7EM8koOWj74je5Lx1Y3y-KWIUEPeOZ1rdmHBw7f7Kh01Ymxki18ob9hCingeRUH7ZPzebVMX7Q22_v1t49IwQw6fcs6Pq9uB1HsgsYfqL9kdriSoljJFBysWwmD3GpDYPbA_y7NaeQdgQ2oHuDCWFVWSCP1kcoC6Ra6jEMP1FTCro4TdhOHSUEa)**
**I believe God put me here for a reason. **
**I believe Minnesota is the land of 10,000 problems right now. **
**And I believe a no-BS, sane person who 's ALL-IN can win this seat. **
** But I'd be lying if I said fundraising doesn't make a difference in a race like this. The far-Left is readying a FORTUNE to drown out our message and take this seat out of play. **
**Our path to victory solely depends on raising enough to keep up. **
**My finance team tells me we 'll need to bring in 10,000 founding donors ASAP so we can: 1) Hire staff, 2) Recruit volunteers in every corner of the state, 3) Print yard signs, 4) Launch our first advertising blitz, and 5) Start contacting on-the-fence voters. **
**I 'm afraid that'll make the difference between a winning campaign and a losing one.

# **Anti-ICE agitator William Kelly arrested for church disruption after taunting Pam Bondi**
William Kelly, one of the anti-ICE agitators who disrupted a service at Cities Church in Saint Paul, Minnesota on Sunday, **[was arrested,](https://substack.com/redirect/349dac6c-337c-4eb2-8035-8fce68e5308d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with FBI Director Kash Patel announcing "A THIRD subject has now been arrested connected to targeting Cities Church in Minneapolis Sunday. William Kelly is now in custody," and DHS Secretary Kristi Noem noting he's "being charged with conspiracy to deprive rights, a federal crime, for his involvement in the St. Paul church riots."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7cfcd155-0c80-4fd1-86ba-9452c2939cff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Kelly dared Attorney General Bondi to arrest him days earlier:** Kelly had said days earlier in a video "Come and get me Pam Bondi, you f---in' traitorous b----," with Attorney General Pam Bondi declaring after his arrest "Our nation was settled and founded by people fleeing religious persecution. Religious freedom is the bedrock of this country. We will protect our pastors. We will protect our churches. We will protect Americans of faith."
* **Kelly berated churchgoers, called them "pretend Christians":** Kelly, who goes by "dawokefarmer2" on social media, shared video of himself berating people at the church, asserting "all these pretend Christians, all these comfortable White people... are living lavish, comfortable lives, while children are dragged into concentration camps" and telling congregants "You're sinners. You're pretending to be Christians. But we know you live an easy life, don't you? A very easy life while people are starving."

* * *
# **JD Vance reveals $7 billion in fraud discovered in California**
Vice President JD Vance **[revealed that about $7 billion worth of fraud has been discovered in California](https://substack.com/redirect/6852d9d5-0171-4194-8fe1-a3ebc3265125?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , telling an interviewer Thursday that the head of the US Small Business Administration gave him the shocking news and noting "I think we have a fraud problem that is much worse than California than it is in Minnesota" and "This is unfortunately a problem that is much bigger than Minnesota."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6852d9d5-0171-4194-8fe1-a3ebc3265125?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **VP says Democratic states waging "small-scale civil war" over immigration:** Vance said efforts to block immigration enforcement were a uniquely blue-state phenomenon, adding that some Democratic-led states are engaged in a "small-scale civil war" with the federal government over immigration, noting "You look at red states like Texas, but blue cities like Austin. You do not see this level of chaos over the enforcement of immigration laws," as governors like California's Gavin Newsom have stepped up opposition to ICE activity.
* **Vance cites church raid, ICE shooting as examples of far-left chaos:** Vance pointed to Don Lemon and other protesters storming a Minnesota church as well as the killing of Renee Goode, saying "a small band of very far-left people" are trying to make ICE "the ultimate enemy" through assaults on officers and raids on churches, calling it "absurd" and saying "It's added a lot of chaos," as DHS launched a major fraud investigation in Minnesota targeting refugee applications.

* * *
# **Trump pulls Canada 's invitation to "Board of Peace" after Davos speech**
President Donald Trump **[withdrew Canada's invitation to his newly launched "Board of Peace"](https://substack.com/redirect/dd556ca6-8dcd-4704-81ba-3188b2cb809b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** late Thursday on Truth Social after Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney used a World Economic Forum speech in Davos to lecture about the end of U.S.-led global leadership, with Trump writing "the Board of Peace is withdrawing its invitation to you regarding Canada's joining, what will be, the most prestigious Board of Leaders ever assembled, at any time."
* **Carney argues "rules-based order" is a "fiction," praises Xi Jinping:** Without naming the U.S. or Trump directly, Carney argued Tuesday that the "international rules-based order" has become a "fiction," saying "the strong do what they can, and the weak suffer what they must," with his remarks coming days after he declared a "new world order" during a China visit and praised the "leadership of President Xi Jinping."
* **Trump and Carney engage in public sparring over U.S.-Canada relations:** Trump told the WEF audience Wednesday that Canada "lives because of the United States--remember that, Mark, the next time you make your statements" and "should be grateful," while Carney fired back Thursday insisting Canada "thrives because we are Canadian," not because of American support, as tensions rise with Trump floating using "economic force" to pressure Canada to become the 51st state.

subject: A National Voice on School Choice — Join Us February 10
body:

| |
---
| Good morning Friend,
Momentum on education freedom is building in Mississippi — and this is the moment to be part of the conversation. With **HB2 having passed the Mississippi House and now moving to the Senate** , school choice is no longer theoretical. Decisions being made right now will directly impact Mississippi families, students, and communities. That’s why we’re hosting **Education Freedom** on **Tuesday, February 10 at 11:30 AM** at **River Hills Club**. We’re honored to welcome **Corey DeAngelis** , one of the nation’s leading school choice advocates and a key national voice in the education freedom movement. Corey’s work has helped shape school choice reforms across the country, and the momentum behind these policies continues to grow — including support from the Trump administration and the U.S. Department of Education, which has publicly highlighted Mississippi’s progress on education freedom. This conversation will also feature Mississippi leaders who are driving education reform on the ground:
* **Starla Brown** , **State Director of****Americans for Prosperity Mississippi** , whose grassroots efforts have been instrumental in advancing policies that expand opportunity and empower families across our state.
* **Lindsey Beckham** , **State Chair, Mississippi Legislative Chair, and Madison County Chapter Chai****r** **for** **Moms for Liberty** , a leading voice for parental involvement and accountability in education.
* **Leah Ferretti** ,**Director of****Mississippi Ready** , a statewide initiative focused on expanding education options and ensuring Mississippi families can access the learning environments that best meet their children’s needs.

---

Politico: Trump says individuals will soon be prosecuted for 2020 election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=012326_1&amount=25]
Donald Trump flew to Davos, Switzerland this week, Team, to meet with and give a speech to our European allies. So, of course, President Trump spent his time talking about the 2020 election as he threatens not to hold elections in 2026 . In his own words:
“ It's a war [Ukraine] that should have never started and it wouldn't have started if the 2020 US presidential election weren't rigged. It was a rigged election. Everybody now knows that. They found out. People will soon be prosecuted for what they did. ”
Again, millions of taxpayer dollars have been spent by MAGA elected officials across multiple states looking for evidence of election fraud in 2020, and nothing has been found. Despite years of effort by opponents of voting rights, no valid proof of any misdeeds relating to the 2020 election has been brought to light, even as wave after wave of suppressive legislation has been made law.
Now, Trump is also threatening prosecutions. Who is he targeting? We don't know, even though his MAGA Department of Justice has sued Fulton County, Georgia (home to Atlanta) for ballots and other election materials from 2020. What we do know is that Trump has already weaponized the federal government against his perceived political opponents, like former FBI Director James Comey and New York Attorney General Letitia James. Is his 2024 opponent, Kamala Harris, next? 2020 campaign staff? Or Joe Biden himself?
What we do know is that this is all wrong, and we have to defend our fundamental right to vote before it's too late . The fate of mail-in ballots, early voting programs, voter outreach initiatives, and voter registration drives depends on our work right now, ahead of November.

Trump has also repeatedly sought to assert federal control over elections, which are run by the states.
This is a big red warning sign for our elections coming up and our fight for voting rights in general. If the sitting president still can't accept defeat years later after winning another election and returning to power, what makes us think he'll accept election losses by his party in November?

Already, Trump and his team have accomplished more than most presidents could hope to achieve in a full four years.
This administration is what I like to call Trump 2.0--and if you want to know more about what makes it so important, you can check out my new book [here](https://substack.com/redirect/3e54f877-ff4b-4501-aa71-8c1a26e340c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But I want to recap year one of Trump in office, and explore where we go from here.
The White House issued a [list](https://substack.com/redirect/c6f9262b-4aa5-4d97-84d5-c7d073a5dd77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of 365 accomplishments in his first 365 days in office.
These next three years are going to be critical in defining America, both here at home and abroad.
And the foundation that the administration has laid in this first year makes me optimistic about what's ahead.

body:
Donald Trump is weaponizing the federal government to target his political opponents. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123890831/596906447/-1228673924?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjY2JlZTRmYi03Y2Y4LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Y7ZWmhKeh-mgfzli422OoRldR6QhTbvgRZXx0O13sJo=)
After I reminded our servicemembers of their obligations to uphold their oaths to the Constitution, Donald Trump called for me to be arrested, tried for treason, and executed.

Then the President and his MAGA lackeys launched a bogus FBI inquiry into me and other veteran Members of Congress who dared to speak out against this corrupt administration.

**Now, Trump is sending his political cronies at the Justice Department, including former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, to try and threaten and intimidate me.**

_Thanking "Reddit John"_ In the wake of the recent Brown tragedy, many have asked how we can recognize Reddit John – the anonymous Brown alum whose courage helped investigators track the perpetrator. In this bitter winter cold, East Side City Councilwoman Davidson and I are working together to raise a gift -- to be donated _in John’s name_ \-- to support unhoused neighbors. The gift will go to [Open Doors](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.s333gSbyhQmXsyCO3lhAD7_qdkIZ7fQ60IIt1iyFMcTGT81vzUQpOgvkIWeBFslz7PRFflPYmm6fa-xAyid1x8p5JA5Ehz5pFPmS4BJt0x4ktY5nydENmzXnOBbmNIH03cuA6QowCjYZsiVL4Rk1hIypsjqbmrwac0BwN5rnLxUABp-L81HWJm3MtRxP2ZXmW2wTTOgQea5DmosFvsCpsb0iThBcaLYNtmj0xPuEu22C7ent-_XxgCyz73N0GE6uz-QYf62o8GZiAM8u8h9wS1PrFmZI4ws_P1hqLCdeuYTrZwDFOx68u1kdj9v8_boa_DT4VWP5urgaMBUyZ_KGpOQHqq8wmWqeYOHnDyxEiqY/4nj/SNayn3ghT6KGhXGWreB6WQ/h9/h001.mOFNZgiEs3AwFA7fW8H1WuGkzOLk6ozKyiuVM6RSIO8), a Rhode Island non-profit doing critical frontline work to house and support people in Providence and beyond. Our understanding has been that John has chosen to remain anonymous -- and he also showed what it means to care for a community when it matters most. We know that many of our neighbors are also struggling with housing insecurity during this time. _But obviously - if and when there are opportunities to send care directly to Reddit John, we will let you know (and we know this community will show up for him!)_. Until then, let’s honor his care with care. Oscar nominations are out, and it feels like _One Battle After Another_ is already a lock to win Best Picture. Maybe _Sinners_ pulls off an upset, but I wouldn't bet on it.
In that spirit, before I bring you into our latest fight, I want to give you a sense of how last year stacked up.
In short: We won practically every major lawsuit against a federal agency.
In total, we protected roughly **$1.5 billion** of your tax money, keeping it here in North Carolina.
That averages out to roughly **$4 million per day** \- or about 5% of the entire state budget.
So we're talking real money.
But it's not just money - these wins protected jobs, public education, medical research, health care, infrastructure, disaster response, law enforcement, and food for kids.
That's a solid track record, but keep in mind, these wins represent only a handful of the _10,000 active cases_ at our office. We're very busy.
## **Our latest battle: Funding for rural schools**
Our newest battle with a federal agency was, once again, forced on us.
With just weeks left in the year, the Department of Education abruptly told us that they were cutting $50 million from North Carolina schools.
And the cut would take place on January 1st - _in the middle of the school year._
Of the $50 million cut, most of it would hit rural schools - including a number of counties hit hard by Hurricane Helene.
This funding comes from a nearly 50-year-old program that gives schools local control to support students in practical ways. Depending on their local needs, schools use that money to provide things like after-school programs, literacy and career prep, food support, and mental health services.
So cutting that program is bad, but "bad" is different than "unlawful."
Here's why it's also unlawful:
When schools applied for the funding, they told the Department exactly how they would use it. The Department pre-approved all the plans. Gave them the green light. Funded them.
So schools hired staff based on that green light. They built programs relying on that approval.
Now - without even _alleging_ any misuse of the funding - the Department is pulling the rug out.
Can't do that.
Federal law says that once Congress funds a program and grants are awarded, a department can't simply change its mind midstream unless there's evidence that funds are being misused.
So we're going to court. (Here's a **[video](https://substack.com/redirect/5c20ff57-420c-455d-84cf-88e114c2eded?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** I did explaining our case.)
If this feels familiar, it's because we won a similar lawsuit last year against the Dept of Ed when they tried to abruptly cut $165 million for NC schools on one week's notice.
We'll see how this unfolds, but I like our odds. I'll keep you posted.
## **A quick note on the Lighthouse Fund**
Here's a question I get a lot:
"What should our message be?"
And that's a good question, but here's a better one:
"How do we _reach_ people with a message?"
Figuring out message reach is much harder than figuring out message content.
One big way we're reaching people is by running videos like the one I linked above as an ad on various social media platforms. It's all about reaching independent voters _before_ the campaign heats up, just to stay on their radar.
That effort is called the Lighthouse Fund, and if you can, I'd appreciate your support for it either **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/1b759e38-c1bb-449d-b2f9-97feb852e7c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , if you use ActBlue to donate, or **[here](https://substack.com/redirect/3b80eb3c-7184-4752-a411-cedf0ecec271?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** if you don't use ActBlue.
And thanks for helping us keep the light on.

clean_body: And a new fight for rural schools | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more And a new fight for rural schools | | | Jan 23 | | | | | | | | | | | | Oscar nominations are out, and it feels like One Battle After Another is already a lock to win Best Picture. Maybe Sinners pulls off an upset, but I wouldn't bet on it. In that spirit, before I bring you into our latest fight, I want to give you a sense of how last year stacked up. In short: We won practically every major lawsuit against a federal agency. In total, we protected roughly $1.5 billion of your tax money, keeping it here in North Carolina. That averages out to roughly $4 million per day \- or about 5% of the entire state budget. So we're talking real money. But it's not just money - these wins protected jobs, public education, medical research, health care, infrastructure, disaster response, law enforcement, and food for kids. That's a solid track record, but keep in mind, these wins represent only a handful of the 10,000 active cases at our office. We're very busy. Our latest battle: Funding for rural schools Our newest battle with a federal agency was, once again, forced on us. With just weeks left in the year, the Department of Education abruptly told us that they were cutting $50 million from North Carolina schools. And the cut would take place on January 1st - in the middle of the school year. Of the $50 million cut, most of it would hit rural schools - including a number of counties hit hard by Hurricane Helene. This funding comes from a nearly 50-year-old program that gives schools local control to support students in practical ways. Depending on their local needs, schools use that money to provide things like after-school programs, literacy and career prep, food support, and mental health services. So cutting that program is bad, but "bad" is different than "unlawful." Here's why it's also unlawful: When schools applied for the funding, they told the Department exactly how they would use it. The Department pre-approved all the plans. Gave them the green light. Funded them. So schools hired staff based on that green light. They built programs relying on that approval. Now - without even alleging any misuse of the funding - the Department is pulling the rug out. Can't do that. Federal law says that once Congress funds a program and grants are awarded, a department can't simply change its mind midstream unless there's evidence that funds are being misused. So we're going to court. (Here's a I did explaining our case.) If this feels familiar, it's because we won a similar lawsuit last year against the Dept of Ed when they tried to abruptly cut $165 million for NC schools on one week's notice. We'll see how this unfolds, but I like our odds. I'll keep you posted. A quick note on the Lighthouse Fund Here's a question I get a lot: "What should our message be?" And that's a good question, but here's a better one: "How do we reach people with a message?" Figuring out message reach is much harder than figuring out message content. One big way we're reaching people is by running videos like the one I linked above as an ad on various social media platforms. It's all about reaching independent voters before the campaign heats up, just to stay on their radar. That effort is called the Lighthouse Fund, and if you can, I'd appreciate your support for it either , if you use ActBlue to donate, or if you don't use ActBlue. And thanks for helping us keep the light on. Best, Jeff ? | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Jeff Jackson Jeff Jackson for Attorney General, P.O. Box 470882 Charlotte, NC 28226, United States ? ?

name: Nico, United We Dream
subject: DACA death by a thousand paper cuts
body:
We are living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 13-year history. | | | Peter, There’s no shying away from the facts: **This administration has chipped away at DACA in the courts and on the streets.** Immigrant youth are anxious and fearful about their safety and their futures amidst increasingly broader and more violent mass raids targeting immigrant communities and allies across the country. More than 65 DACA recipients — the vast majority with active status — and immigrant youth were detained by immigration agents in 2025. While that’s played out on the ground, the bureaucrats have continued to erode DACA protections. In 2025, the administration:
1. Barred DACA recipients from accessing health insurance through the Affordable Care Act, affecting the approximately 11,000 DACA recipients who were enrolled in the ACA.
2. Challenged and blocked access to higher education through attacks on in-state tuition to immigrant students, including DACA recipients, in five states.
3. Rescinded access to commercial driver’s licenses to certain immigrants, including DACA recipients.
4. Coordinated with TSA to share travelers’ data with immigration enforcement agencies to target immigrant youth.

**In the face of all of these attacks — the physical violence and the erosion of protection — United We Dream will continue its direct work in our community** , with trainings for non-violent resistance, support for activists in the thick of it, information and resources, and a safe place for all of us to gather together in peace. We also won’t stop advocating for Congress to take action; to stand against the administration’s mass delegalization efforts and its latest efforts to target DACA recipients and weaken the DACA program. There’s a concrete solution on the table now, the bipartisan _Dream Act_ — a bill that would give a pathway to citizenship to immigrants who have lived in the U.S. for most of their lives, contributing to our communities, economy, and workforce. Congress must act with urgency. This moment requires getting it done. Now, more than ever, we’re guided by love, power, resiliency, and the creativity of our people. **That will never change.********** [**If you are able to support United We Dream’s work during this time, your contribution will help us empower immigrant youth, demand accountability from those in power, and keep our communities informed. clean_body: We are living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 13-year history. | | | Peter, There’s no shying away from the facts: This administration has chipped away at DACA in the courts and on the streets. Immigrant youth are anxious and fearful about their safety and their futures amidst increasingly broader and more violent mass raids targeting immigrant communities and allies across the country. More than 65 DACA recipients — the vast majority with active status — and immigrant youth were detained by immigration agents in 2025. While that’s played out on the ground, the bureaucrats have continued to erode DACA protections. In 2025, the administration: 1. Barred DACA recipients from accessing health insurance through the Affordable Care Act, affecting the approximately 11,000 DACA recipients who were enrolled in the ACA. 2. Challenged and blocked access to higher education through attacks on in-state tuition to immigrant students, including DACA recipients, in five states. 3. Rescinded access to commercial driver’s licenses to certain immigrants, including DACA recipients. 4. Coordinated with TSA to share travelers’ data with immigration enforcement agencies to target immigrant youth. In the face of all of these attacks — the physical violence and the erosion of protection — United We Dream will continue its direct work in our community , with trainings for non-violent resistance, support for activists in the thick of it, information and resources, and a safe place for all of us to gather together in peace. We also won’t stop advocating for Congress to take action; to stand against the administration’s mass delegalization efforts and its latest efforts to target DACA recipients and weaken the DACA program. There’s a concrete solution on the table now, the bipartisan Dream Act — a bill that would give a pathway to citizenship to immigrants who have lived in the U.S. for most of their lives, contributing to our communities, economy, and workforce. Congress must act with urgency. This moment requires getting it done. Now, more than ever, we’re guided by love, power, resiliency, and the creativity of our people. clean_body: - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! subject: City of St. Louis Winter Weather Update
body:

January 23, 2026
---
## ❄️ City of St. Louis Winter Weather Update
### 🧂 Free Salt for Residents
The City of St. Louis Street Department has placed **1.5 tons of salt** for **residential use** at the following locations:
1. **STLFD Engine House 1** – 2911 Jefferson Ave.
2. **STLFD Engine House 6** – 5747 Manchester Ave.
3. **STLFD Engine House 12** – 5214 W. Florissant Ave.
4. **STLFD Engine House 36** – 5000 S. Kingshighway Blvd.
5. **STLFD Headquarters** – Jefferson Ave. & Cass Ave.

🪣 **Please bring your own bucket or container.**

Residents are encouraged to pick up salt **before winter weather arrives this weekend**.
## 🧊 Cold Weather Safety Reminders
### Stay Warm
* **Warming centers** (libraries & community centers) are open during regular hours
* Call ahead, as hours may change
* For locations or shelter assistance, call **United Way 211**

### Emergency Alerts
* Stay informed: **Text STLCEMA to 888777**

### Avoid Injuries
* Walk slowly on ice and snow
* Wear slip-resistant footwear
* Watch for black ice
* Keep hands free when walking (use backpacks)

### Home Care
* Protect pipes from freezing
* Follow Red Cross winter home safety tips

## 🐾 Pet Safety
* Pets should **not be left outdoors for extended periods**
* Outdoor animals must have **adequate shelter, food, and water**
* Failure to provide care may result in **animal cruelty charges**
* **Animal Control:**
* Daytime: 314-657-1500
* After hours/weekends: 314-231-1212

🧺 **Free Straw for Warm Paws**
* Available at **Animal Care Center** , 2801 Clark Ave.
* Hours: 10am–5pm, daily

## 🚗 Vehicle Safety
* **Do NOT leave your car running unattended** (City Ordinance No. 68137)
* If you’re concerned about someone’s safety in the cold and can’t reach them, **call 911**

---
| | |
---
**About Steve Roberts**
Senator Steven Roberts, a fourth-generation St. Louis native, was sworn into office on January 6, 2021, to represent Missouri’s 5th Senatorial District and was selected as the Democratic Whip for the Minority Caucus. Previously, he served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and chaired the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus. A graduate of the University of Miami and Pepperdine Law, he has worked in Congress, as a prosecutor in St. Louis, and as a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard’s JAG Corps. He also manages Roberts Law, LLC, and remains active in Missouri’s legal and civic communities.

| | Some of the leaders who get the least attention end up having significant sway over major questions before our government, such as... Whether families can afford to go to the doctor. Whether people can exercise their freedom to vote. Whether children can go to well-funded public schools. Whether communities have to live in fear of gun violence. Whether reproductive freedom is a reality or a rallying cry. Whether the criminal legal system delivers justice or perpetuates inequities. **Healthcare, voting rights, education, gun safety, reproductive freedom, criminal justice reform — these are all issues where state legislatures wield immense power.** **And these are all issues where it could be far harder, if not impossible, to achieve progress for years to come if anti-democracy extremists get their way in an upcoming Supreme Court decision that’s expected soon.** If the court decides to gut Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act — the central safeguard against racially discriminatory redistricting — GOP legislatures across 10 Southern states could redraw voting maps to decimate fair representation and minority political power in state legislatures. By eliminating around 191 state legislative seats currently held by Democrats, they could wipe out two out of every five districts where Black or Hispanic voters make up the majority — erasing nearly half of all Black-majority districts in the South. **Communities of color would lose their representatives in the halls of power where key decisions get made.** **And GOP legislatures could lock in Republican supermajorities for a generation — stripping Democratic governors of veto power and blocking progress on issues that touch people’s daily lives.** We’re getting ready to act fast in the event of this Supreme Court ruling. From grassroots organizing and public education to coalition building and pressure campaigns, we will fight our hearts out to stop politicians from rigging new voting maps, and there will be plenty of ways for this whole team to be involved. Whether families can afford to go to the doctor. Whether people can exercise their freedom to vote. Whether children can go to well-funded public schools. Whether communities have to live in fear of gun violence. Whether reproductive freedom is a reality or a rallying cry. Whether the criminal legal system delivers justice or perpetuates inequities. Healthcare, voting rights, education, gun safety, reproductive freedom, criminal justice reform — these are all issues where state legislatures wield immense power. And these are all issues where it could be far harder, if not impossible, to achieve progress for years to come if anti-democracy extremists get their way in an upcoming Supreme Court decision that’s expected soon. If the court decides to gut Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act — the central safeguard against racially discriminatory redistricting — GOP legislatures across 10 Southern states could redraw voting maps to decimate fair representation and minority political power in state legislatures. By eliminating around 191 state legislative seats currently held by Democrats, they could wipe out two out of every five districts where Black or Hispanic voters make up the majority — erasing nearly half of all Black-majority districts in the South. Communities of color would lose their representatives in the halls of power where key decisions get made. And GOP legislatures could lock in Republican supermajorities for a generation — stripping Democratic governors of veto power and blocking progress on issues that touch people’s daily lives. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Want to know what my morning routine is as a U.S. Senator?

**Coffee, crosswords, and cardio.**

Keeping up with this administration’s attacks requires _a lot_ of caffeine. I’m spending my day in the U.S. Senate strategizing to fight back against the Trump administration and RFK Jr.’s attacks on our public health system — putting kids, folks with disabilities, and vulnerable communities at risk.

Here’s his latest:

🛑 RFK Jr. replaced experts of a key CDC vaccine advisory committee with anti-vaxxers and MAGA loyalists.

🛑 RFK Jr. effectively ended a vaccine public awareness campaign — setting the stage for even more vaccine disinformation and pseudoscience.

🛑 RFK Jr. completely disrupted the childhood vaccine schedule, putting babies and kids at risk of contracting previously eradicated diseases like the measles.

_And that’s only the half of it._

Look, RFK Jr. isn’t an influence we can easily ignore. He is one of the most powerful members of Trump’s Cabinet as the Secretary of Health and Human Services.

I’m doing everything in my power to call out RFK Jr.’s lies and counter his dangerous disinformation campaign, but I could use your support.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CITIZENS ALLIANCE OF NEW HAMPSHIRE]()
body:
The Public Employee Choice Act, is moving through the House Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee, and your voice is needed now...

| | | | | [|
---](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=36394724fb&e=8c8e704ee6)
| | | | | | Peter,

Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is calling on you to take immediate action!

House Bill 1704, the **Public Employee Choice Act** , is moving through the House Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee, and your voice is needed now to help advance this important legislation.

[HB 1704](https://citizensalliancenh.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9ec7dd6f72fe3fc1550cd2695&id=a4978306b0&e=8c8e704ee6) empowers public employees in New Hampshire, including teachers, state workers, municipal employees, and others, to bargain individually with their public employers on wages, hours, working conditions, and grievance adjustments **without any interference** from unions or exclusive bargaining representatives.

This bill aligns perfectly with The Pledge's principle of **voting to expand economic freedom for individuals** that our 94 Pledge Champions in Good Standing uphold.

Public employees deserve the freedom to represent themselves if they choose, and no one should be forced into collective bargaining against their will.

**The committee needs to hear overwhelming support from constituents like you.**

A strong showing of emails urging an "**Ought to Pass** " recommendation will help push HB 1704 forward and send a clear message that New Hampshire values personal freedom and choice in employment.

Send a short email to members of the House Labor, Industrial, and Rehabilitative Services Committee and let them know you support House Bill 1704!

# KEVIN KIJEWSKI EARNS LANDSLIDE ENDORSEMENT IN OTTAWA COUNTY REPUBLICAN CONVENTION

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**West Olive, MI** – Kevin Kijewski, the proven America First fighter for Michigan Attorney General, secured a landslide victory last night at the Ottawa County Republican Party's Endorsement Convention, **106 votes to 6 – nearly 95% support** – in one of the state's most conservative strongholds.
This overwhelming endorsement earned the immediate backing of Ottawa County GOP Chairman Joel Studebaker. Building on Kevin's earlier commanding win at the prestigious Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference straw poll – the flagship early indicator of grassroots strength – this decisive Ottawa result reflects surging momentum as Republicans prepare for the March 28 statewide endorsement convention.
"I'm deeply grateful to Ottawa County Republicans and Chairman Joel Studebaker for this landslide vote of confidence and endorsement," said Kevin Kijewski. "The precinct delegates – grassroots leaders who know our conservative principles best – have spoken clearly. In the heart of West Michigan conservatism, this decisive support, following our Mackinac straw poll victory, shows our message is resonating: restoring trust in elections, standing up for parental rights, backing law enforcement, and delivering courtroom results against government overreach. As your Attorney General, I'll fight every day to protect Michigan citizens and families – just as I did when I successfully got [politically motivated charges against President Trump's alternate electors dismissed](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=de21bcea0a&e=4b10910eed), and [keeping high schools open during COVID lockdowns](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=52408f7561&e=4b10910eed) through federal litigation.”
Ottawa County, a stronghold for election integrity and rock-solid conservative principles, has delivered this early and commanding endorsement – a clear indicator of the momentum that will carry Kevin to victory at the March statewide convention and position him as the strongest candidate to defeat the Democrats in November.
Kevin continued: "Thank you to Chairman Studebaker and Ottawa County GOP leadership for this honor. Together, we're building the team to make Michigan red again – securing our elections, defending our rights, and putting families first."

subject: They Asked "What's the Hyde Amendment?" – I Didn't Hesitate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TREY TRAINOR FOR TEXAS
body:
Opponents fumbled on life, energy, and border security. I delivered conservative answers rooted in real experience.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/537ccc2edce1/post-bexar-gop-candidate-forum-01-22?e=4d3fe76c62)
---
[|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=051c648444&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | | | | | Peter,

Last night, I participated in the **Bexar County GOP** Congressional District 21 candidate forum at Norris Conference Center, and the momentum from that strong showing has me more fired up than ever today.
From the opening statements to the questions on supporting ICE, slashing wasteful spending, defending life, and putting America First, I delivered clear, principled, no-nonsense answers rooted in my record. As a lifelong defender of conservative values, an election law attorney, and a former Chairman of the Federal Election Commission, appointed by President Trump, I contrasted sharply with the field.
The room felt it—multiple attendees approached me afterward (and some reached out this morning) to say my responses were the strongest, most substantive, and most connected to the grassroots energy we need in Washington. I clearly stood out among all the candidates as the one with the most policy experience. Several moments highlighted the difference:
* One of my opponents, when asked about the [**Hyde Amendment**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=172638230a&e=4d3fe76c62) —a key touchstone of our pro-life positions—had to respond with "...what's the Hyde Amendment?" It was a stark reminder that not everyone in this race has the depth of understanding on core conservative issues that I've fought for over years.
* Another was questioned on **renewable energy** and answered that "...they need government support," showing a willingness to keep expanding federal subsidies rather than letting the free-market drive innovation.
* When one candidate was asked whether children of illegals should be separated because of **deportations** , they had to be coached from the audience on what the conservative position actually is—highlighting a lack of readiness on border security and immigration enforcement.

---
[|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=df25ed9e07&e=4d3fe76c62)
| |

In contrast, I fielded each question quickly, confidently, and with in-depth knowledge of conservative principles, drawing directly from my experience defending election integrity, supporting Texas Right to Life priorities, and standing with President Trump.
In fact, one attendee came up to me after the forum and said, "You're clearly on the varsity and the rest of these folks are on the JV." That kind of feedback from the grassroots tells the story—the voters know the difference between real experience and talking points.
This forum was a decisive moment in our primary. With the March 3rd primary approaching fast, momentum is building, and it’s on our side. To ensure we have the resources to win, I need your immediate financial support today.
Your [**contribution right now**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=4a8a9ac271&e=4d3fe76c62) will directly fuel voter outreach, grassroots organizing, and the final push to secure this seat for true conservative leadership.
Please [**donate today**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=c0d304dac1&e=4d3fe76c62) at [**trey4tx.com**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=5dbc980902&e=4d3fe76c62) and help send a proven, America First fighter to Congress. If you are unable to give at this time, you can still make a difference by [**volunteering**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d3f9434c89&e=4d3fe76c62) or helping spread the word to like-minded conservatives across the district.
**Together, we will win this race and take proven conservative leadership to Washington.**
Best regards,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative Fighter for TX-21

Dear _Flyover_ Reader, I'm writing to you personally because yesterday we announced something important -- and I didn't want it to pass without speaking to you directly. There are only days left to invest in _The Flyover_.
This offering ends this month.
And when it closes, it's over. No extensions. No reopening. No second chances in this round. I know you've seen a lot from us lately. That's intentional. Moments like this don't come often -- moments where readers have a real chance to shape the future of news instead of just consuming it. **Why This Matters** Legacy media didn't lose trust by accident.
* They chose clicks over facts.
* Outrage over reporting.
* Celebrity journalists over accountability.
* Political agendas over common sense.

Americans noticed. That's why _The Flyover_ was born -- and why it's growth is exploding while legacy media continues to shrink. In just over two years, we've become one of the fastest-growing, profitable media companies in America:

* Our podcast is reaching close to a million viewers/listeners each month
* We're expanding state by state, platform by platform

This didn't happen because of venture capital, corporate takeovers or political backing. It happened because readers stepped forward. **What We 're Building Next** As we look ahead, our focus is clear:
* Expanding into texting and mobile-first delivery
* Launching _The Flyover_ app
* Growing our podcast into a true national platform
* Adding more state editions to serve readers locally and honestly

This is how we continue to take market share -- not by being louder, but by being better. **A Personal Ask** If you're a _Flyover_ reader, you already understand what makes this different. If you believe facts still matter.
If you believe Americans deserve news without spin.
If you believe doing nothing isn't the answer anymore. That belief only turns into real change when people act. I'm asking you -- personally -- to consider joining us before this round closes. Not just as a reader, but as an owner. As someone who helped take a stand for common-sense when it mattered. If _Flyover_ readers step forward together, we can do something truly rare: Change the media -- without becoming what we replaced. There are only days left. This round ends this month. clean_body: Hi folks! I just made it official: I‘m running for U.S. Senate! - my name is Michele Tafoya. I made a career as a sideline reporter for some of the biggest moments in sports history. I spent many Sunday evenings out on the gridiron. And I 've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I 'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I 'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... - STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool 's errand. After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it 's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. But blazing my own trail has never scared me. I made history on TV and won four Emmys for my sports coverage. I 've taken on longer odds than this - and I beat them. I'm taking on Tim Walz's inner circle, the DC power brokers, and the political class who have sold us out for too long. Luckily, there are a lot more of us than there are of them! Now that I have made my decision, my path to winning this Senate race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents. That last part is important - because if we can't get our message out far and wide, this race is over and the far-Left wins. | | ---|--- This just became one of the biggest Senate races in the entire country. I mean it. I'm already hearing that the career politicians are terrified of my campaign. They 're scared because 120+ million people saw a viral video showcasing rampant fraud happening under Tim Walz's watch. They 're scared because folks know who I am and they know I don't take BS from anyone - not from players on the field and certainly not from some empty suits in DC. And they 're scared because they know that if the American people have to choose between fraud, incompetence, special interests, and powerful party bosses... And honesty, common sense, and plain talk - the political class is in for a reckoning. Are you with me? I can 't do this without you! Thanks for taking the time to read this email! Together, we 're going to make history - I can feel it in my bones. Be brave. | Hello Forward Friends- I hope everyone enjoyed the long weekend. I grew up in Atlanta, GA, so Martin Luther King Jr is a historical figure near and dear to my heart. My favorite quote of his, "Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about things that matter", really motivates me every day to wake up and keep doing this work, hoping it makes even the tiniest impact in the lives of others. I am truly grateful to those of you who read these and attend our volunteer events, you make it all worthwhile! Next week on **Mon Jan 26th at 7pm ET** we are launching a Recruitment Challenge. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kim Schrier for Congress
body:
Literally NO ONE asked for this. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123898691/596931655/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGNlNGYyMC04YWY4LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TP6GDuVfk5czfaDCBvVYaTQwZHXIbp7MUNqUOZQJJl4=&emci=f6b1160b-1cf6-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=8dce4f20-8af8-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=15820338)
---
Peter,

The Trump administration just took a hammer to mental health and addiction services across the country. **More than $2 billion in federal grants were cut with no warning.**

These weren't abstract programs or line items on a spreadsheet. This funding paid for overdose prevention, naloxone distribution, peer recovery support, and mental healthcare for people in crisis.

For many communities, it was the safety net. But thanks to Trump and his yes-men, overnight, providers were told to shut down services or prepare to close their doors. That means that families already struggling with addiction or mental illness are going to be left with fewer options and nowhere to turn.

At a time when people are asking their government for help, Donald Trump took it away without a second thought. This decision is cruel and reckless. These programs save lives, and cutting them puts people in danger. Communities were finally seeing progress, and now that progress is being ripped apart for absolutely no good reason.

clean_body: Literally NO ONE asked for this. Peter, The Trump administration just took a hammer to mental health and addiction services across the country. More than $2 billion in federal grants were cut with no warning. These weren't abstract programs or line items on a spreadsheet. This funding paid for overdose prevention, naloxone distribution, peer recovery support, and mental healthcare for people in crisis. For many communities, it was the safety net. But thanks to Trump and his yes-men, overnight, providers were told to shut down services or prepare to close their doors. That means that families already struggling with addiction or mental illness are going to be left with fewer options and nowhere to turn. At a time when people are asking their government for help, Donald Trump took it away without a second thought. This decision is cruel and reckless. These programs save lives, and cutting them puts people in danger. Communities were finally seeing progress, and now that progress is being ripped apart for absolutely no good reason. Peter, mental healthcare and addiction treatment should never be politicized. Thank you, Team Schrier Rep. name: Colin Allred
subject: I made a difficult decision to end my campaign.
body:
Peter,
I officially ended my campaign for U.S. Senate and filed to run for Congress in Texas’ 33rd Congressional District.
I didn’t come to this decision lightly – I’ve put everything I had into my Senate campaign over the last five months, traveling to every corner of the state, talking to as many Texans as I could, building on the incredible grassroots campaign we started last year.
While it was clear that many Texans were ready to support me to the end, it was also clear that the Democratic primary would end up in a bruising and costly runoff in May. And if we want to prevent another MAGA loyalist from representing our state for six more years, that’s simply a risk we can’t afford to take.
So, today I am announcing my campaign to represent the newly drawn 33rd district in Texas. If you’d still like to see me head to Washington in November, I hope you’ll consider splitting a donation between me and Real Texas to get my new campaign off to a strong start today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=012326_1]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Colin Allred and The Real Texas PAC will go through immediately:

District 33 was racially gerrymandered by Republicans in an effort to further rig our democracy, but it’s still the community where I grew up attending public schools and watching my mom struggle to pay for our groceries. It’s the community where Aly and I are raising our two boys. It is my home.
The threats that our democracy and our way of living are facing right now are real. It’s harder than ever for kids like me to get a shot, and for single moms like mine to afford their basic needs. But I am more confident than I have ever been that together, we can beat these threats. There was plenty to be ticked off about in our spending spree yesterday. Some of it was good—a lot of it was disgusting. We funded the Department of Homeland Security, and I’m down with that. We need ICE, and we need a border. What am I mad about? My colleagues didn’t have the guts to make the cuts President Trump wanted. Instead, the left cheered as “Republicans” voted for $1.17 trillion in appropriations. A chunk of that will inevitably go to mutilating children and serve the trans agenda. There’s a lot of other junk in there, too. You can watch my walkoff video to get the full picture. Thank y’all for sending me here, Tim | | Join the conservative movement! # Trump eyes Greenland minerals to crush China dominance
President Trump announced a framework deal with NATO that **[grants the US and allies mineral rights in Greenland,](https://substack.com/redirect/294b2737-e1c7-46a2-9695-6e5505a0b4b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** aiming to secure vast rare earth reserves and block China's strategic access to these critical defense materials amid escalating Arctic tensions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c2db30c-bfb8-4eb4-b5b5-1a200507e221?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rare Earth Riches Unveiled** : Greenland holds the world's eighth-largest reserves at 1.5 million metric tons, featuring major deposits like Tanbreez and Kvanefjeld vital for magnets in defense and tech industries.
* **China 's Stake Blocked**: A Chinese firm Shenghe Resources maintains investment in the stalled Kvanefjeld project, but US efforts including past lobbying prevent Beijing from gaining further foothold in Arctic resources.
* **US Backing Boosts Projects** : Critical Metals' Tanbreez acquisition received a $120 million US Export-Import Bank interest letter, sparking a stock surge and advancing domestic rare earth supply chain independence.
* **Security Over Extraction** : Trump emphasizes the deal's focus on national security and countering China/Russia Arctic ambitions rather than immediate mining, citing high costs and ice challenges for long-term strategic gains.

# Gold surges past $4900 milestone Goldman ups forecast
Gold prices **[shattered records by topping $4900 per ounce](https://substack.com/redirect/e018b0e7-6f5c-4111-8662-fdc726dbdc61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for the first time amid relentless demand, as Goldman Sachs boosted its year-end 2026 forecast to $5400 citing accelerating private-sector diversification into the metal.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e018b0e7-6f5c-4111-8662-fdc726dbdc61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Private demand surges** : Goldman highlights emerging private investor and high-net-worth buying as a key realized upside risk, joining central bank purchases to fuel the rally.
* **Forecast sharply raised** : Goldman lifted its December 2026 gold target by $500 to $5400 per ounce from prior $4900, expecting persistent positions amid policy uncertainty.
* **Geopolitical boosts noted** : Events like US actions on Venezuela and tariff threats have triggered rallies, reinforcing gold's role as a hedge in turbulent times.
* **Analyst upside views** : UBS sees potential to $5400 if tensions flare, recommending gold allocation in portfolios facing dollar and AI-related risks.

# Private credit meltdown risk surges on Wall Street
Wall Street is **[sounding alarms over rising risks](https://substack.com/redirect/7c8bede5-c4f0-4c05-acad-d0e22b157885?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the booming private credit market, now $3.4 trillion strong, as high-profile bankruptcies, opaque valuations, and warnings from Jamie Dimon and Jeffrey Gundlach fuel fears of hidden troubles that could spark broader financial stress in 2026.
* **Rapid growth fuels** : Private credit has ballooned from post-2008 bank restrictions and is projected to hit $4.9 trillion by 2029, creating conditions ripe for systemic issues due to light regulation and low transparency.
* **Experts issue stark** : JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns problems spread like cockroaches, while billionaire Jeffrey Gundlach slams "garbage loans" and predicts the next crisis will originate in private credit.
* **Valuation concerns mount** : Lenders face incentives to disguise risks and delay markdowns, as seen in cases like Renovo where debt was initially valued at full before dropping to zero amid stress.
* **Defaults and stress** : Rising defaults expected this year especially among weaker borrowers, with more firms using payment-in-kind options to avoid formal defaults and banks facing growing exposure through $1.14 trillion in loans to nonbank lenders.

Our exclusive Capitalist deep dive exposes the shady practices that have been commonplace in the sub-prime private credit market, that no one is paying attention to.

# Airlines scramble waivers chaos winter storm looms
Major U.S. airlines including Delta, Southwest, American, and United issued travel waivers and **[began preemptively canceling flights](https://substack.com/redirect/c1be6f2e-4d6b-4e64-9a62-5a817298786e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday as a massive winter storm threatens heavy snow, sleet, ice, and bitter cold across two dozen states, with thousands of disruptions expected over the weekend into Monday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c1be6f2e-4d6b-4e64-9a62-5a817298786e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Delta preempts cancellations** : Delta canceled flights Thursday at select airports in Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, and Tennessee for safety, automatically rebooking passengers to next available itineraries.
* **Southwest offers broad flexibility** : Anticipating South and East disruptions, it allows rebooking or standby travel within a two-week window without fees for affected customers.
* **United targets Northeast Mid-Atlantic** : Waiver covers much of the region including Newark and Washington-area operations, waiving change fees and fare differences for same-itinerary adjustments.
* **Storm brings historic impacts** : Forecast delivers cold not seen in five years, potential power outages, tree damage, and ripple effects even to distant hubs like Denver and Chicago.

* * *
* * *
# Waymo unleashes robotaxis in Miami shocker
Alphabet's Waymo **[launched its fully autonomous robotaxi service](https://substack.com/redirect/247d4fb0-14f4-4b46-8410-58e2c1c2e4d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to paying riders in Miami on Thursday, opening a 60-square-mile area across trendy neighborhoods like Brickell and Wynwood as the company's sixth U.S. market and first expansion of 2026, bolstering its dominance over lagging rivals like Tesla.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/247d4fb0-14f4-4b46-8410-58e2c1c2e4d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Service Area Details:** Covers 60 square miles including Design District, Wynwood, Brickell, Coral Gables with airport extension planned soon.
* **Rider Onboarding Process:** Nearly 10,000 locals signed up as early new riders invited gradually via Waymo app for controlled rollout.
* **Operational Partnerships:** Waymo has teamed with Moove for fleet charging cleaning and repairs following testing start in early 2025.
* **Expansion Ambitions:** Waymo targets more US cities like Dallas, Denver and Houston in 2026 after 14 million trips and 450,000 weekly rides in 2025.

# _Artic Front Heads Our Way_
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |

**I wanted to take this opportunity pray over Harris County and the Nation with you today.**

**I can’t say that I can remember a more all-encompassing storm as the one blanketing our nation right now. It almost feels as though it is type-and-shadow of what is playing out nationwide politically in so many urban settings - we have a literal storm as well as a metaphorical one brewing just beneath the surface.**
**The Nation is stressed and divided in a way that I haven’t seen in all of my years.**
**So let’s pray:**
_**Heavenly Father,**__**We ask that You would calm the storm as it makes its way across our nation. We ask that turmoil, death and destruction would be brought to naught. We ask that You would cover us, that you would be our fortress and our refuge. We pray for the strength and resilience of our electrical grid, that it would be protected in a supernatural way. We pray for the Divine protection of every single living soul in the wake of this storm, that all would come through unscathed and that all the glory would belong to You.**__**We ask this in the Mighty Name of Jesus.**__**Amen.**_****
Godspeed, Patriots. Stay Warm. - Warren Howell

That's why, Team, we're going to keep highlighting these stories. We have to make sure every eligible voter understands the threats against voting, the stakes of our elections, and has the information they need to get registered and stay on the rolls.

The Independent: Trump DOJ admits DOGE Social Security staff worked with political group trying to ‘overturn election results’ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012326_2&amount=25]
Two members of Elon Musk’s DOGE team at the Social Security Administration were secretly working with a right-wing advocacy group trying to “overturn election results,” the Trump Department of Justice admitted in a court filing.
While the Social Security Administration (SSA) has not yet admitted whether voter data was actually shared with the group, SSA did admit the agreement bypassed internal safeguards designed to prevent exactly this kind of misuse of personal government data.
SSA also did not release the name of the right-wing political group that the DOGE staffers engaged in unauthorized communications and data planning tied directly to election denial efforts. We can be reasonably sure that it's MAGA-aligned, however.
This news is being lost in the avalanche of terrible things the Trump administration is doing, but this is a blaring red siren for both November and future elections . We must spread the word about this blatant attempt to overturn election results while we hold the administration accountable for this privacy violation and, above all, defend our fundamental right to vote.

body:
Learning to Pray for the Persecuted Christians of Iran| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | There is a church growing rapidly in one of the most unlikely places on earth—and you will never see its buildings, billboards, or worship services livestreamed online.

It is the underground church in Iran.

I have personally spent hours with these precious believers throughout the years, as many are so starved for teaching, discipleship, and encouragement that they frequently cross over the northern border with Iraq. I have worshiped with them, shared scripture together, and been marked by their zeal for the Lord.

While headlines often portray Iran only through the lenses of geopolitics, nuclear tensions, or unrest, a quieter and far more powerful story is unfolding beneath the surface: tens of thousands of Iranians are encountering Jesus Christ, often through dreams and visions, and choosing to follow Him at tremendous personal cost.

This is not Christianity as a cultural accessory. This is Christianity as a life-or-death decision.

A Church Forced Underground

In Iran, converting from Islam to Christianity is illegal and considered apostasy. House churches are raided. Pastors are imprisoned. Believers are interrogated, surveilled, and pressured to renounce their faith. Many lose their jobs, their families, and their freedom simply for confessing the name of Jesus.

It is the underground church in Iran. I have personally spent hours with these precious believers throughout the years, as many are so starved for teaching, discipleship, and encouragement that they frequently cross over the northern border with Iraq. I have worshiped with them, shared scripture together, and been marked by their zeal for the Lord. While headlines often portray Iran only through the lenses of geopolitics, nuclear tensions, or unrest, a quieter and far more powerful story is unfolding beneath the surface: tens of thousands of Iranians are encountering Jesus Christ, often through dreams and visions, and choosing to follow Him at tremendous personal cost. This is not Christianity as a cultural accessory. This is Christianity as a life-or-death decision. A Church Forced Underground In Iran, converting from Islam to Christianity is illegal and considered apostasy. House churches are raided. Pastors are imprisoned. #
Peter —
Tomorrow afternoon, James will debate Jasmine Crocket one-on-one.
It’s a huge moment for our movement. Everybody will be watching. Our campaign is surging, and voters, the media, and our opponents are all asking if James has what it takes to win on March 3.
We can’t falter now. **[If you believe James is our best chance take back Texas, please consider making a contribution to let him know you have his back before he takes the stage.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q1.AKJ3HX&refcode=em260123-1-ak&t=1&akid=403%2E1347274%2Er4oWwG)**
Right now, the corporate media, pundits, and national Republicans are waking up to the fact that James has a path to victory — on March 3 and in November. John Cornyn just admitted that himself, calling James “dangerous” and a threat to Republicans’ Senate majority.

clean_body: Folks – Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! The next round of hearings for Trump’s judicial nominees is almost here.
And if history is any guide, Senate Democrats are preparing to make the
same disastrous mistake — again.

Trump isn’t nominating neutral arbiters of the law. He’s nominating
loyalists and enablers. Judges hand-picked to protect his power, excuse
his crimes, and rubber-stamp authoritarianism from the bench.

These nominees won’t say Biden won the 2020 election.
They won’t condemn January 6.
They won’t even admit an insurrection happened.

Why? Because their job isn’t to defend the Constitution — it’s to stay in
Trump’s good graces.

And yet, time after time, there have been 18 Senate Democrats who have
waved them through.

Every confirmation hearing is a line in the sand. Every Democratic vote to
advance these judges is a green light for Trump to keep hijacking the
courts — long after he leaves office.

We're done pretending this is inevitable.

Demand Justice is sounding the alarm now, before the hearings begin, to
force Senate Democrats to do the bare minimum: block Trump’s nominees and
stop helping him rig the judiciary.

That means aggressive public pressure. That means naming names. That means
making it politically painful to side with Trump’s judges over democracy.
But we can’t do it alone.
