Every Democratic vote to advance these judges is a green light for Trump to keep hijacking the courts — long after he leaves office. We're done pretending this is inevitable. Demand Justice is sounding the alarm now, before the hearings begin, to force Senate Democrats to do the bare minimum: block Trump’s nominees and stop helping him rig the judiciary. That means aggressive public pressure. That means naming names. That means making it politically painful to side with Trump’s judges over democracy. But we can’t do it alone. RuthsListFL.org [RuthsListFL.org]
Peter,
We’re officially at the end of week 2 of Florida’s 2026 Legislative Session – and bills are moving quickly through committee and onto chamber floors.
Here’s a quick update on the bills we’re tracking that have made progress in the last two weeks:
✅ HB 1151 / SB 1308 Reproductive Freedom Act: Sponsored by House Minority Leader Fentrice Driskell and Senate Minority Leader Pro Tempore Tracie Davis, this act would restore Floridians’ right to make their own decisions regarding reproductive healthcare, without government interference.
Ask you representatives to support HB 1151/SB 1308 [https://www.weareplannedparenthoodaction.org/a/hb-1151-sb-1308-action?_gl=1*qlj3z2*_gcl_au*MzQxNjQzMjg3LjE3NjkwMTIyOTM.*_ga*MTk0NTU3ODcyMi4xNzY5MDEyMjkz*_ga_ENXC8KHJL8*czE3NjkxMTI5NDAkbzQkZzEkdDE3NjkxMTMwNTgkajEzJGwwJGgxNzE0NDExNjU2]
❌ SB 164/HB 289 Civil Liability for the Wrongful Death of an Unborn Child: This bill just had its vote on the House Floor and our Ruth’s List women led the fight against this dangerous legislation —- explaining how it won’t only strip away the reproductive freedom of millions of women across the state, but would jeopardize their access to fertility and emergency care services.
And even after explaining the extreme consequences facing Florida’s women, Republicans still voted to pass the bill 76-34. But we’re not done fighting yet. The Florida Senate still has to move its companion, SB 164, through committees and onto the Senate Floor. That’s why we’re urging you to contact your Senator now and tell them to vote no on SB 164. [https://www.weareplannedparenthoodaction.org/a/sb164-hb289-action]
Contact Your State Senator [https://www.weareplannedparenthoodaction.org/a/sb164-hb289-action]
❌ SB 1090/HB 1071 Education: This bill passed its first committee stop on Wednesday, despite lawmakers and members of the public voicing deep concerns over its potential effects on sexual/reproductive healthcare education in Florida schools.
While parents can currently opt their children out of such courses, SB 1090/HB 1071 would require all parents to opt-in to this type of instruction – creating a confusing administrative hurdle for parents and schools, and threatening students’ access to important information about their health and safety. Additionally, this bill would mandate the use of content made by one of America’s largest, most extreme anti-choice organizations. Materials like the notorious “Baby Olivia” video inject political opinions into the curriculum, instead of providing students with accurate, balanced instruction when they need it most.
This bill has made progress in the Florida House, but we still have the power to stop it in its tracks. Please, take a moment and contact your Representatives now and tell them to vote no on SB 1090 and HB 1071. [https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/planned-parenthood-florida-action/session/indoctrination-in-public-schools-sb-1090-hb-1071]
Contact Your Representatives [https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/planned-parenthood-florida-action/session/indoctrination-in-public-schools-sb-1090-hb-1071]
And here's a quick look into what Ruth's List women have been up to during the 2026 Legislative Session:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/15639/images/Untitled%20design%20%285%29.png]
Opening week brought Delta Sigma Theta and Alpha Kappa Alpha Sororities’ Founders’ Days to our state’s Capitol. Our Delta and AKA alums celebrated and strengthened their bonds of sisterhood, and showed that they have each others’ backs in Tallahassee. We are so proud of this coalition of pro-choice women (pictured here) for fostering unity and building community all while fighting for our rights and freedoms.
No matter what the Republican supermajority throws our way, Democratic members and advocates are ready to keep their spirits up and continue fighting for the hardworking people of our state. And with your support, we can make our voices heard and stop bad legislation from stripping away our rights and freedoms.

body:
We’re getting closer to the redistricting finish lines!

As MAGA-controlled legislatures across the country have quickly redrawn congressional maps to rig the midterm elections, Virginia is taking emergency measures — and we need your help.
With this amendment, Virginians have the power to protect democracy. As the people of the Commonwealth face the real risk of having their voices diminished, this is a temporary and necessary response to ensure fair representation at the national level.
With your help, **this amendment will put power back in the hands of the people.**
With so many other states primed to redraw congressional maps without voter approval, we must act now to restore and protect fairness in our elections before midterms.

Once public media is gone, there’s no easy way to bring it back

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d5d0025f-b531-49c8-bb48-8ed95ee612b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
President Nixon signs the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) on January 1, 1970.
I'm writing this because I've seen what happens when growth, profit, and industrial expansion are allowed to run without guardrails. And because a lot of people in the United States have forgotten just how bad it can get.
If you are older, you might remember pieces of this. If you are younger, you probably never saw it at all. And if you have never left the country in any meaningful way, you almost certainly do not understand the scale of it.
This is not about arguing whether it is cold outside today or whether winter disproves climate change. That conversation is lazy.
This is about what happens when there is no oversight, no regulation, and no enforcement. When companies are left to their own devices in the name of growth and profit. When the environment becomes an externality instead of a shared responsibility.
* * *
## America Is Beautiful Because We Fixed What We Broke
The United States is an incredibly beautiful country. From an environmental perspective, it is wildly underrated.
I have driven across the country, up and down both coasts and have been to roughly forty states. I lived in Hawaii. Our national parks, metro parks, lakes, rivers, coastlines, and geographic diversity are extraordinary. You cannot easily find that range of natural beauty anywhere else in the world.
But it is easy to forget that it was not always this way.
I remember visiting the [Heinz History Center](https://substack.com/redirect/76581d16-aedf-4604-bcd5-991673b7d539?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Pittsburgh and seeing exhibits showing what the city looked like at the height of industrial pollution. The sky darkened during the day. Eyes and lungs burned. Rivers were choked with waste.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6c6dca21-d5e9-438b-8dc2-4d8579f68969?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[What Pittsburgh Looked Like When It Decided It Had a Pollution Problem](https://substack.com/redirect/a47101be-8e46-4c1f-b003-72de601f52f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Cleveland was no different. Buildings above certain heights were stained black and gray from soot. The smell of sulfur and chemicals hung over Slavic Village and the river. I remember going to Edgewater as a kid and my mother commenting on how polluted it was and seeing dead fish everywhere. And yes, the river caught fire. More than once. Actually, I think somewhere of 13 significant burns are recorded.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5fa69c15-4303-4a32-ac0e-8e7c42729c85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
California had its own version. Smog trapped between the mountains, the city, and the ocean. The smog hung in the air like a permanent fixture, as iconic as the Hollywood sign announcing your welcome to Los Angeles. Until it was addressed and it did not fix itself.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da1d066b-1be5-4709-9aee-a5884cb99b7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Los Angeles under cover: LA Times**
Republicans and Democrats alike stepped in. Richard Nixon signed the legislation. The EPA was created. Regulations were enforced. Cars became cleaner. Industry became cleaner. Dumping was restricted. Standards were imposed.
Not because corporations suddenly grew a conscience, but because they were forced to.
* * *
## Regulation Worked. That Is Not a Theory.
We forget this because we can look outside and see blue skies.
What people forget is that it was regulation that got us here. Enforcement. Standards. Limits. Accountability.
It was not just the visible pollution either. Lead. Forever chemicals. Industrial dumping. The casual pouring of paint, oil, detergents, and chemicals down drains. I grew up in the 80s. This was normal behavior then.
Even now, we are still dealing with the long tail of it. Microplastics and nanoplastics in our bodies. Chemicals leaching from cookware, plastic containers, plastic wrap, and recycled plastic utensils when heated. Hormone disruption. Chemical imbalances. We just accept it as background noise now.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/274e68bd-e557-431c-a18e-0d6d7e4e6b8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**[Scientists Discover Alarming Amount of Microplastics in Your Brain- And It Could Be Fueling Depression and Dementia](https://substack.com/redirect/86442c91-dfdc-4add-a0be-120e12a25591?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We forget how far we have come because the worst of it is no longer visible to us.
* * *
## I've Seen What "No Regulation" Actually Looks Like
From 2004 to 2010, I lived in Beijing during the peak of Chin's growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c07719a3-f197-40d6-8869-7f8177d5bc97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Beijing air pollution study could unlock solution to persistent smog | Air pollution | The Guardian](https://substack.com/redirect/61c36d5c-dca1-4b16-b945-fd514801649c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There were days in Beijing when the air was so thick with pollution that you could not see thirty story buildings across the street. The sun did not shine. It glowed dimly, like a weak streetlamp behind a dirty shade. After a day outside, your eyes hurt. Your nose hurt. Your throat hurt.
I still think sometimes that if I die of cancer, it will be lung cancer from breathing that air for years.
And then something important happened.
The Chinese government intervened. Aggressively. Deliberately. Standards were imposed. Enforcement followed. Blue skies returned. Clean days became possible.
That did not happen by accident.
Meanwhile, in Southeast Asia, I have seen rivers that flowed around trash instead of water. Beaches with as much garbage as sand. Cities clogged with smog from millions of small engines spewing black smoke. Drinking water that no one trusted, forcing entire populations to rely on bottled water. Billions of plastic bottles piling up in landfills and makeshift dumps in the middle of neighborhoods, and of course, in every body of water.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aaad3394-fb28-4aa3-ba98-7240a0944d33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Most polluted rivers in Southeast Asia](https://substack.com/redirect/d6001b7e-fc67-4adb-b3d9-06d5b19195a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
## The Cost of Forgetting
Lately, there has been a lot of talk about rolling back regulations. Weakening the EPA. Opening national parks to drilling. Framing environmental enforcement as an obstacle to growth.
That kind of thinking only exists because people have forgotten how bad it was.
I agree there needs to be balance. Forced, unnatural timelines. Unrealistic mandates. Blunt policy instruments can harm economies and markets, especially in the West where we already did much of the work.
But that does not mean we abandon the lesson.
Most future pollution growth is coming from rapidly developing regions in Asia and emerging economies in Africa. That does not absolve us. It makes global coordination more urgent. Pollution does not respect borders. I watched China's pollution spill into Hong Kong, Taiwan, and neighboring countries in real time.
The Great Pacific Garbage Patch is still there. I saw how ocean currents collect trash and deposit it in one place while living on the Big Island of Hawaii. It is almost as if the ocean is doing us a favor by piling our mess together and pleading with us to deal with it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9605e637-4492-4828-92b4-26e02fa27da0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Great Pacific Garbage Patch
* * *
## Prevention Is Cheaper Than Amnesia
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d70c74a3-60c5-4c3f-9148-951b06d10648?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
China is by far the biggest CO2 emitter in the world
It is easy to laugh off environmental concerns when you wake up in a place that already cleaned up its mess decades ago. When the worst damage happened before you were born. When enough time has passed that collective memory fades.
[And if you want a real-time reminder of how fast that slide can happen, look at the push to allow drilling and fracking underneath public land, including Ohio state parks](https://substack.com/redirect/c480d7cc-5d93-40d9-b094-65d3662caf55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and protected areas. That is not "energy independence." That is turning the last places we all share into a balance sheet.
It is the same logic as always: public risk, private upside. The moment we start treating protected land like it is just another asset to monetize, we are back on the same road that gave us blackened buildings, burning rivers, poisoned water, and decades of cleanup bills that regular people pay for while executives cash out.
But profit-driven deregulation without guardrails always runs the same way. It runs fast. It runs dirty. And it leaves damage that takes generations to undo.
An ounce of prevention really is worth far more than the pound of cure we would need if we let this run unchecked again.
I have seen what "no oversight" looks like.
Trust me. You do not want to relearn that lesson the hard way.
**Stay Angry.**

name: Wendy Davis
subject: Here’s why I endorsed Gina Hinojosa
body:
I believe that Texas Democrats can beat Greg Abbott.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**I will _always_ be proud to be a Texan, Peter.**
**But lately it’s become hard to recognize the state I love.**
I grew up in a Texas that allowed me to reach for my dreams, a state that made it possible for a single mom to eventually go to law school and later serve her community on the Fort Worth City Council and in the Texas Senate. A Texas where your future wasn’t determined by your past, income, or zip code.
But the past ten years under Governor Greg Abbott’s leadership have proven to be a difficult and challenging time for our state. Abbott has been busy defunding our public schools, stripping health care away from tens of thousands of people, removing protections for workers who are hurt on the job, and preventing honest, hardworking Texans from getting a leg up and a chance at fulfilling their dreams.
Now, more than a decade after he was elected, Abbott’s priorities have meant the closure of hospitals across rural Texas as well as the closure of countless public schools. Doctors are leaving our state in droves, and we’re having a harder and harder time recruiting the best and the brightest to come to Texas for their graduate studies.
It’s become crystal clear who Abbott represents: his billionaire donors, big corporations, and far-right ideologues instead of hardworking Texans and their families who are struggling every day.
Now more than ever, we need a real leader who won’t back down when it counts. **That’s why I’m proud to support my friend Gina Hinojosa for Governor of Texas.**
I’ve watched Gina stand her ground in the toughest fights — from defending our public schools to standing up for Texas women. Now I’m thrilled to have her back.
**[If you’re with us, will you support Gina’s campaign with a $5 donation?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260123_1_wendy.so26Ts&refcode=em20260123-468&amount=5&t=1&akid=468%2E299639%2EqON4A6)**
Texans deserve a governor who fights for them, but instead have been saddled with one whose corruption knows no bounds — a governor who spends his time serving Donald Trump and the MAGA agenda instead of the people of Texas.
Our country is facing a critical and historic test right now. And Republican leaders like Greg Abbott are failing miserably.
**I believe that Texas Democrats can beat Abbott.** But we need a real fighter to do it. Luckily, Gina has taken on Abbott before. _She’s not afraid of the fights ahead._
Most recently, when Abbott and the GOP introduced highly-partisan congressional maps at the behest of Donald Trump, Gina helped lead Texas House Democrats in a quorum break, leaving the state and delaying the GOP’s illegal gerrymandering.
Gina also took on Abbott’s school voucher schemes, beating him _five times in a row._
Gina has a record of fighting back for every Texan who has ever felt left behind. She is the fighter we need to end the Abbott era and reclaim the Texas that we all love. And let me tell you right now, this election is going to be the fight of our lives.
When I ran against Greg Abbott in 2014, he spent millions of dollars attacking me and spreading misinformation about my record and my vision for Texas. His warchest has only grown since then — and he’s going to spend whatever it takes to hold onto the governor’s office so he can keep pursuing his dangerous agenda.
**That means that the only way Gina can win is with the strongest foundation of support we can provide right now. She needs a commitment from each and every one of us to _never back down_ and to do everything we can in this fight.**
**[Peter, contribute $5 now to elect Gina Hinojosa as Governor of Texas so we can beat Greg Abbott, the billionaires, and big corporations _together._](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260123_1_wendy.so26Ts&refcode=em20260123-468&amount=5&t=2&akid=468%2E299639%2EqON4A6)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260123_1_wendy.so26Ts&amount=5&refcode=em20260123-468&t=21&akid=468%2E299639%2EqON4A6)
Thank you for believing in the promise of Texas.
With hope and gratitude,
Wendy Davis
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260123_1_wendy.so26Ts&refcode=em20260123-468&t=22&akid=468%2E299639%2EqON4A6)

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Yesterday, one of my primary opponents tried to come after me for supporting Medicare for All
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1600%2E251025%2EPVlLH_ ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1600%2E251025%2EPVlLH_ ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

Yesterday, one of my primary opponents tried to come after me for
supporting Medicare for All. 👇

[ Alt ]A post from @MalloryMcMorrow: 'On an issue as important as healthcare,
you have to be honest about what you’re fighting for –– not rewriting
definitions to have it both ways. The Medicare for All legislation that
you’ve championed completely eliminates private health insurance as it
exists today.' the post is quoting a post from @AbdulElSayed:'Defending a
healthcare system that’s failing us is our own American version of
Stockholm syndrome (except they’ve got much better healthcare in
Stockholm). My thoughts with @briantylercohen:'

You read that right, Medicare for All — a policy the overwhelming majority
of voters support.

In her comment, she says, “You have to be honest about what you’re
fighting for,” and I agree. So, here are some honest truths about Medicare
for All and this campaign:

* Medicare for All guarantees every single American public insurance.
But it doesn’t completely eliminate private health insurance. Every
American would automatically have Medicare, and private insurance
could supplement or duplicate Medicare. The key is everyone would have
guaranteed healthcare — something our country currently lacks.
* Big Pharma and health insurance corporations make obscene profits off
a broken system — so they pour cash into politics to protect it. They
fund candidates and pundits who will “raise concerns,” muddy the
waters, and make sure nothing ever changes.
* That’s why you can’t trust politicians who have taken corporate PAC
money. Not only am I the only candidate in this race who supports
Medicare for All, but I’m also the only one who has never, and will
never, take corporate PAC money. That means you can rest assured I’m
fighting for your best interests, not some health insurance CEO’s.

Peter, moments
like this make the stakes of our primary election clear. We have a choice:

1. Stick with a politics where candidates attack popular, common-sense
policies to please those who profit from a broken system.
2. Or, support a campaign where we’re honest about what working people
actually need, and refuse to sell out behind closed doors.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260123-1-ak.rP2sjM&amount=10&refcode=em20260123-1597&t=1004&akid=1600%2E251025%2EPVlLH_ ]If you’re ready to stand up to corporate healthcare interests and pass
Medicare for All, I hope you’ll chip in $10 or any amount
today.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260123-1-ak.rP2sjM&amount=10&refcode=em20260123-1597&t=1023&akid=1600%2E251025%2EPVlLH_ ]Donate $10 ››

In solidarity,

Abdul

body:
logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Screen%20Shot%202023-11-12%20at%207.15.37%20PM.png]
Resolutions Beyond Ourselves
It is impossible to arrive at the end of the year without taking time to reflect on all that has passed. For generations, this season has also marked a moment to set goals and personal ambitions for the year ahead. As we set our intentions collectively, I challenge you to ask not only what you can do for yourself, but what more you can do for the community you call home. As we look toward 2026, there are countless reasons to move beyond conversations about what’s happening around us, and instead take part in shaping the change we want to see.
Turning this intention into action can begin with being heard. Next week, I hope you will join me at three town hall meetings across the district, which will be an opportunity to listen, learn and engage directly on the issues that matter most to you and your family.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/2025/New%20Years%20Newsletter/f0efc669-3b34-45e6-a0a9-68c53df9a28c.png]
Further, for those unable to attend in person, our legislative survey offers another opportunity to share your priorities and help shape my work in the upcoming legislative session. Whether in person or virtually, your participation ensures we’re making these decisions together!
Take our 2026 Legislative Survey [https://secure.ngpvan.com/HeihXcmhnkeeSrJT39dqpw2]
Sign-Up for Virtual Henrico Delegation Town Hall [https://us02web.zoom.us/meeting/register/xMZVEQmwSXOZBGFe6S1XUQ#/registration]
Sign-Up for Petersburg Town Hall [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/1-8-26]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/Newsletter/Untitled%20design%20%2831%29.png] 2025 in Review
Serving our district is both an honor and a responsibility I take pride in. Thanks to your continued engagement 2025 while not without its challenges, allowed me to make tremendous legislative progress towards our shared priorities. Further, the partnerships we’ve strengthened are nothing short of remarkable as so much of the work done by community organizations is felt by people daily. Like you, I will spend the next few days reflecting on the year behind us and I look forward to the year ahead. Know that I remain committed to listening, learning and leading with your voice at the center of every decision I make.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/89018/images/2025/New%20Years%20Newsletter/2025%20Year%20in%20Review.png]
Again, from my family to yours, Happy New Year!
- Lashrecse

body:
Triple match active, don’t wait.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM0Mjc3MjkS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjM4MDI1NDgwMwS2&mt=1&rt=0).

[**_Renew your LCV membership today while our January Membership TRIPLE MATCH is active and your support goes_** _**_three times_**_** _as far to defend our communities. Every $5=$15 >>_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
---
| | Peter — Trump’s EPA just announced plans to gut a key part of the Clean Water Act, limiting the authority of states and Tribal nations to protect their water sources.
---
| | The proposed limits on state and Tribal powers could pave the way for the new construction of coal export terminals, toxic mines, oil and gas pipelines, and other projects that cause harmful pollution.
---
| | To put it plainly: Trump’s plan would make our waters dirtier and families sicker at a time when healthcare costs are already going up for millions.
---
| | Poll after poll shows that people reject Trump’s attacks on the environment when they learn about them. But the truth is, the kind of public outcry we need to force Trump to reverse course needs to be massive, and too many people still don’t know about this threat to our water.
---

Peter, it's Mark.

I am suing the Secretary of Defense.

After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like this. Hegseth has left me no choice.

Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to punish me because they don’t like what I have to say. Their attacks are directed at me right now, but they’re trying to send a message to every retired member of the military:

Speak out against us and we will come after you with every tool we have at our disposal. We’ll censure you, we’ll threaten your rank and retirement, and we might even court-martial you.

It’s unconstitutional, so I’m suing them. Beyond this lawsuit, it’s important we send a message to Trump and Hegseth to show them just how many people are on this team to defend constitutional rights. That’s where you come in.

I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do.

That’s how we’ve made it this far, and it’s how we’ll get to the other side of this chapter in our nation’s history. Together.

If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make a stand and join the fight, this is it.

**The most essential preparation fo****r our children is to disciple them to follow Jesus Christ. We know that it’s important to take our children to church, read scripture with them, and pray with them daily. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Stories from Minnesota
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260123-1857-foote&t=1001&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter, these
are accounts from Minnesota in the days since the murder of Renee Good.
Please read on.

ICE agents at a Target in Richfield, Minnesota grabbed a teenage employee
who was heckling them — as is your legal right — and threw him to the
ground. They shoved him in a van and drove away.

The boy was an American citizen who was yelling that he had his passport
in his pocket. They didn’t listen until he was detained. Since they had no
authority to arrest him, agents dumped him in a Walmart parking lot down
the road with no way to get home. He was found injured, bleeding, and
crying for help. A child.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]ICE agents at a Target in Richfield, Minnesota grabbed a teenage
employee who was heckling them — as is your legal right — and threw him to
the ground.

Christian Molina, a Latino man and US citizen, was driving to work in
South Minneapolis when ICE agents crashed into his car to force him to
stop. Why? Because he looked “illegal.” Christian refused to cooperate
with the illegal stop. When neighbors came to the scene to observe and
support, ICE tear gassed the crowd and left.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]Christian Molina, a Latino man and US citizen, was driving to work in
South Minneapolis when ICE agents crashed into his car to force him to
stop. Why? Because he looked “illegal.”

Christian Molina’s car after ICE rammed into him.

At a gas station in St. Paul, a man was practicing his legal right to film
and observe ICE activities when an ICE agent randomly grabbed him. More
agents came over and violently threw him to the ground, arrested him, and
dragged him away to an unmarked van. Arrested for exercising his First
Amendment rights.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]At a gas station in St. Paul, a man was practicing his legal right to
film and observe ICE activities when an ICE agent randomly grabbed him.

At an electric car charging station in Minneapolis, ICE agents went car to
car looking for people of color, asking each to prove they were citizens
or risk being dragged away.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]ICE agents going car to car looking for people of color, asking each to
prove they were citizens or risk being dragged away.

At a protest in Minneapolis, multiple masked ICE agents detained a
protester and US citizen by grabbing her by the throat and choking her.
She was thrown into an unmarked van and disappeared.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1006&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]Multiple masked ICE agents detained a protester and US citizen by
grabbing her by the throat and choking her.

In Richfield, ICE swarmed the car of a US citizen with guns drawn, forced
him out, and made him get on his knees, an unlawful detention under the
Fourth Amendment. After he confirmed his citizenship, they had no choice
but to let him go.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1007&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]In Richfield, ICE swarmed the car of a US citizen with guns drawn,
forced him out, and made him get on his knees, an unlawful detention under
the Fourth Amendment.

In Minneapolis, ICE approached a US citizen and community volunteer,
shattered his car window, dragged him out, and threw him to the ground. As
they arrested him, they put a knee on his neck: An illegal maneuver that
caused the death of George Floyd in 2020.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1008&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]In Minneapolis, ICE approached a US citizen and community volunteer,
shattered his car window, dragged him out, and threw him to the ground. As
they arrested him, they put a knee on his neck.

If you can believe it, I could keep going. There are hundreds if not
thousands of incidents like these in just the last two weeks. Folks
outside of Minnesota may not understand the scale and severity of the
chaos that ICE has unleashed.

Every day, ICE is harassing, beating, arresting, and violating the civil
rights of US citizens and immigrants alike.

If Trump can sic this fascist violence on Minnesota, he can do it
anywhere, on any of his political opponents and those who choose to stand
up for their communities.

We’ve talked about Trump’s many violations of the Constitution, but what
is happening in Minnesota right now is a dire Constitutional crisis: an
all-out assault on the rule of law and civil rights by out-of-control
government thugs that face zero accountability. We’ve seen this story play
out before in Germany, Italy, and fascist states throughout history. It
can’t happen again.

I’m calling on progressives across the country to stand with Minnesota and
help us fight back against ICE’s crackdowns. We cannot let them get away
with terrorizing our neighbors and beating people in the streets.

If you can, [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1009&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]consider a contribution to the Squad Victory Fund to
support our movement today. Donating may seem like a small act and simple,
but it makes a world of difference as we build the resources we need to
defeat MAGA and the far-right extremists in the White House.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1028&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]Contribute ››

It’s important for me to share these stories with you, so that Americans
understand the violence and chaos being unleashed by their own president.

It’s unacceptable, and we must fight back for the sake of our democracy.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260123-movement.1IBqni&refcode=em20260123-1857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1029&akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB ]DONATE NOW

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1857%2E342411%2E9tHAuB

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

“An invitation to shop is not an invitation to bring your Glock.” | |

Peter, If gun owners want to bring a gun onto private property that’s open to the public—like malls, hotels, and beaches—they should get permission from the property owner first. **Sounds like common sense, right?** Not according to the Supreme Court of the United States. **The Court heard arguments Tuesday on a Hawaii law restricting guns on private property without express permission.** After two hours of arguments, the MAGA justices appeared poised to rule _against_ common sense gun laws (again) and the rights of property owners to define what’s allowed and not allowed on their property. **Instead, they relied on tired arguments claiming that any laws related to guns whatsoever were a wholesale attack on the Second Amendment.** Chief Justice Roberts said Hawaii’s law treated the Second Amendment as a “second-class” right. Justice Alito agreed. Justice Kavanaugh was ready to call the case right then and there. The Trump administration’s lawyer even went so far as to say Hawaii’s law targets “one class of people” — gun owners. The MAGA justices are trying to apply broad arguments about our “rights” to tear down common sense safety laws.**But where is their concern about our rights, or over protecting**** _actual_****classes of marginalized people, when it comes to trans teenagers, immigrants, voting rights, or even our democracy?** Opponents of the Hawaii law call it the “vampire rule,” because it requires express permission to be allowed in. **But allowing private property owners to assess whether they want to allow a known threat—a vampire or a firearm alike—onto their property should be a no-brainer.** As lawyer Neal Katyal, representing Hawaii’s case said, “There is no constitutional right to assume that every invitation to enter private property includes an invitation to bring a gun... an invitation to shop is not an invitation to bring your Glock.”1 But the MAGA justices are apparently committed to flooding our streets, our schools, and our other public places with as many guns as possible: a recipe for more violence. **It’s clear that the MAGA justices on the Supreme Court are ready to rule in favor of MAGA special interests and against everyday Americans at every turn. That’s why we’re fighting back.** [**United for Democracy won’t be silent while a corrupt and purchased Supreme Court turns its back on our Constitution. Chief Justice Roberts said Hawaii’s law treated the Second Amendment as a “second-class” right. Justice Alito agreed. Justice Kavanaugh was ready to call the case right then and there. The Trump administration’s lawyer even went so far as to say Hawaii’s law targets “one class of people” — gun owners. The MAGA justices are trying to apply broad arguments about our “rights” to tear down common sense safety laws.But where is their concern about our rights, or over protecting actualclasses of marginalized people, when it comes to trans teenagers, immigrants, voting rights, or even our democracy? Opponents of the Hawaii law call it the “vampire rule,” because it requires express permission to be allowed in. But allowing private property owners to assess whether they want to allow a known threat—a vampire or a firearm alike—onto their property should be a no-brainer. As lawyer Neal Katyal, representing Hawaii’s case said, “There is no constitutional right to assume that every invitation to enter private property includes an invitation to bring a gun... an invitation to shop is not an invitation to bring your Glock.”1 But the MAGA justices are apparently committed to flooding our streets, our schools, and our other public places with as many guns as possible: a recipe for more violence. It’s clear that the MAGA justices on the Supreme Court are ready to rule in favor of MAGA special interests and against everyday Americans at every turn. That’s why we’re fighting back. Thank you for fighting against Supreme Court corruption, Stasha Rhodes United for Democracy 1 Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . clean_body: Help us protect our democracy from Governor DeSantis’s map manipulation. | Peter, Florida is already one of the most gerrymandered states in the country, but now Ron DeSantis wants to further rob his own constituents of their rightful representation in Congress— all to please the Sunshine State’s most famous resident, Donald Trump. The governor has called for a special legislative session to further exploit what is already an extreme gerrymander. And if this latest manipulation succeeds, millions of voters—particularly Black and Latino voters—will have their voting power weakened. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = As Ron DeSantis knows, Florida hasn’t always been a red state. From the early 1970s to 2000, more Floridians were registered as Democrats than Republicans. In fact, Florida had a 16-11 split among Republican and Democratic congressional representatives before 2022, when DeSantis and his allies passed a gerrymandered map that flipped three seats for Republicans. And it’s why he thinks he can keep diluting the voting power of his constituents. Republicans now have a 20-8 majority over Democrats—and yet they want to manipulate the map even more to give themselves an unearned advantage at the voters’ expense, especially in communities of color. Florida is just one of several states where Republicans are attempting to redraw their maps in order to prevent their party from losing power in this November’s midterm election. clean_body: Folks – Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. And I kept fighting, no matter what the naysayers said. In my years on the sidelines, I 've seen a LOT of underdogs win football games that the "experts" said were impossible. The Minnesota Senate race will be another chapter in that storied history. | | ---|--- Thanks in advance for your support. I'll never forget the good folks who stepped up in the opening days of this campaign. You and I are going to do great things together. I can feel it. Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Join Us At An Upcoming Platform Input Session With 2026 well underway, we are starting our trek across Indiana to hear from Hoosiers about what should be in and what should be the focus of this year's party platform. Our current platform was last updated in 2024 and ratified by delegates to our state convention. The next platform input session will be on Thursday, Jan. 29 at 6:30 PM ET at the IBEW Local 481 in Indianapolis. We will then hold a virtual statewide event on Thursday, Feb 5 at 7:00 PM ET/6:00 PM CT. . Communities Across Indiana Feeling Childcare Crisis Families all across Indiana are feeling the impact of cuts to childcare and the growing waitlist which now includes over 30,000 Hoosier children. We believe when our state has billions in reserve like right now that now family should have to wait to get access to childcare vouchers. The longer families are forced to wait means billions of dollars in lost productivity for the State of Indiana. Estimates show Indiana loses upwards of $4 billion every year from lack of childcare access for families. Now is not the time to wait. Democrats in the Statehouse have proposed fully funding the CCDF and putting thousands of Hoosier parents back to work. Indiana's state government needs to stop the handouts to special interests and begin giving a hand-up to hard working families. It's long past time to end the childcare waitlist. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Nearly a year ago, Governor Mike Braun announced that funding for Dolly Parton's Imagination Library would be excluded from the 2025 state budget. This cut access to the program from thousands of young Hoosier children and toddlers who qualified for free books and materials. At the time, Governor Braun promised to find private sources to continue the funding. But almost a year later and the funds have not been delivered as promised. Just one donor source has been revealed and the program is far short of previous funding. We're standing up for this program because it allows Hoosier families and children access to world-class children's books and a great starting to their future academic success. Statehouse Democrats and State Rep. Gregory Porter are leading the charge to make sure the Governor honors his commitment to find the funding to keep this program running. Anything less would be a disservice to Hoosier families. Friend, President Trump has never been a man to ask what he can do for his country. Now, in his second term, he’s testing the limits of what his country can do for him. From crypto schemes and secret foreign licensing deals to gifts from authoritarian governments and settlements from tech companies, Trump has turned the presidency into a personal piggy bank -- raking in at least **$1.4 billion.** And that’s just what we know...
* **A $400 million private jet from Qatar** \-- the same country he gave access to advanced U.S. chip technology
* **$867 million** and counting from crypto sales tied to policy influence
* **$23 million** from foreign projects licensing his name
* **$28 million** from Amazon for a documentary about Melania

name: Scott Peters
subject: I voted against funding for ICE
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Peters for Congress
body:
---
| | Peter – Yesterday, I voted NO on a bill to give additional funding to ICE. Let me explain why:

Under President Trump, ICE has become a heavily militarized agency operating in our neighborhoods with little accountability and almost no restraint. Its budget has exploded to nearly $85 billion – larger than the Marine Corps – yet families are being torn apart, civil rights are ignored, and fear is spreading in our communities.

Here in San Diego, we’ve seen this firsthand.

Earlier this year, ICE agents stormed a small neighborhood restaurant in our district. They slammed the owner against a wall, handcuffed workers, and used flash-bang grenades on bystanders – all to arrest four peaceful dishwashers, not violent criminals.

That is not public safety.

Instead of focusing on serious threats, ICE is chasing arrest quotas and sweeping up everyone in their path, including children and even U.S. citizens. And despite all this funding, agents are still not held to the same training and accountability standards as our local police.

That’s why I introduced legislation to limit military-style tactics, require body cameras, improve training, and make sure agents intervene when colleagues act unlawfully.

This is about values. The American people want a secure border and safe communities. They want accountability and common sense – not more arrests, more brutality, or more blank checks.

ICE doesn’t need more money. And it doesn’t get my vote. If you have a moment, please reply to this email and let me know what you think.

Thank you for standing with me,
Scott

| | In case you missed it, friends. **Earlier this month, my opponent Jeff Crank, voted against legislation to extend healthcare insurance subsidies under the**** _Affordable Care Act_****(ACA) for millions of Americans.** Without these tax subsidies, _225,000 Coloradans_ will now pay double or even triple the cost for their healthcare coverage. To make matters worse, some [estimates](http://links.reaganforcolorado.com/s/c/B76k_ZXZfSPNoHKEVdwTHkedJM9ZHaBhK1Zcv77dM1R3EBg9weriSTCipVcinwrCIgcjOdKuYPKL-AKDYuDKo_mnjCXREh-YewcYC3HfSI8ZFoFH6FhiMzqG3Ro5i5VIeTkKGXPBOdZ4NN-_vfUeOdfdYIDNJFmswac6-pQ3PNe78Iphz5vTHFZjrrhXxvkrUo1jJ2S1xYprJVSNEAuhiF5Qw3FVochJJaCASLLOD7UtRczj4cmnhse97LbirRYG2baYbwpjZKk1mm3yb1hha-1QbmFMiqV4A7d8Md8wYODHX9neosth9gRlntEeNaLf46gtrBwbQjr9gErBB86I4Rpe7pM_eFv2w4NrGLr5k6d7nEldJwp8p-pShS-YlfoEJ0_gwnsgzO__ppqVCd0W1fSasby_kSP8E_oLiPApPAgKbCYcOMRudpf4hXenImVrUwfigsDOpxgzIUyc7NJHndE8ZCvzmhvi7TLC7Q6XFcXlVrSogFjZZaaPghgRAZc/NhDI-Z0z3DtsRuozysA47kJlvodd-c35/17) show that premium hikes alone could kick nearly _75,000 Coloradans_ off their insurance plans altogether. Mexico City is my home. It's where I was born, where I learned to believe in God's purpose, and where I first saw the kind of poverty and pain that can break your heart.When I speak with our partners there, the stories of children in need make my heart ache.You may know me as the producer of the blockbuster film _Sound of Freedom._ But what you may not know is that the film became the foundation for a massive movement, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation.** A humanitarian organization that rescues children from sex trafficking, supports their recovery, and helps stop exploitation before it begins. In hospitals across Mexico city, vulnerable children, including those rescued from trafficking and abuse, are now fighting to survive. But there aren't enough ICU beds to care for them.Some lie on stretchers or floors, waiting for a chance at healing that may never come.That's why I've set a goal:

**I want to raise $20,000 to deliver $200,000 worth of ICU beds** to hospitals and medical centers that serve God's children in Mexico City.

When these beds arrive, they will go straight into hospitals that have been praying for help, to doctors who refuse to give up, and nurses who comfort frightened children through the night.And the impact doesn't end there. Because when desperate families can access medical care for their children, they no longer face the unthinkable choice of selling a son or daughter just to survive.In communities where poverty and sickness make children vulnerable to traffickers, **a single hospital bed can mean the difference between a child staying with their loving family or being trafficked and abused.** This is what we can change together.We have the plan.
We have the partners.
But this mission can't launch without you.Friend, the next few days will decide how many children we can help, how many will have a bed instead of the floor, and hope instead of fear. If we reach our goal, those hospital rooms will be transformed. The caregivers will have the tools they need. clean_body: Today a child is waiting to be found—will you answer the call? There are no ICU beds left. That's what we're changing, right now. | | | Friend, Mexico City is my home. It's where I was born, where I learned to believe in God's purpose, and where I first saw the kind of poverty and pain that can break your heart.When I speak with our partners there, the stories of children in need make my heart ache.You may know me as the producer of the blockbuster film Sound of Freedom. But what you may not know is that the film became the foundation for a massive movement, the Sound of Freedom Foundation. A humanitarian organization that rescues children from sex trafficking, supports their recovery, and helps stop exploitation before it begins. In hospitals across Mexico city, vulnerable children, including those rescued from trafficking and abuse, are now fighting to survive. But there aren't enough ICU beds to care for them.Some lie on stretchers or floors, waiting for a chance at healing that may never come.That's why I've set a goal: I want to raise $20,000 to deliver $200,000 worth of ICU beds to hospitals and medical centers that serve God's children in Mexico City. These beds are lifelines. They are where a fragile heartbeat stabilizes, where a child's breathing grows stronger, where healing happens. Every $1 you give becomes $10 of real medical value.How?Because through the Sound of Freedom Foundation's partnerships with trusted humanitarian distributors, we're able to secure bulk discounts on high-need medical equipment. That means every dollar raised helps unlock $10 worth of ICU beds, monitors, and lifesaving hospital supplies. enough to care for children who are sick, weak, and desperately in need of help.$25 -> provides $250 worth of ICU equipment and supplies. $50 -> provides $500 toward children's ICU beds. $100 -> provides $1,000 in needed ICU supplies. $250 or more -> helps equip an entire hospital ward for rescued children. When these beds arrive, they will go straight into hospitals that have been praying for help, to doctors who refuse to give up, and nurses who comfort frightened children through the night.And the impact doesn't end there. Because when desperate families can access medical care for their children, they no longer face the unthinkable choice of selling a son or daughter just to survive.In communities where poverty and sickness make children vulnerable to traffickers, a single hospital bed can mean the difference between a child staying with their loving family or being trafficked and abused. This is what we can change together.We have the plan. We have the partners. But this mission can't launch without you.Friend, the next few days will decide how many children we can help, how many will have a bed instead of the floor, and hope instead of fear. If we reach our goal, those hospital rooms will be transformed. The caregivers will have the tools they need. And the children will finally be able to rest, to heal, and to live, safe from the predators who prey on desperation.If we fall short, vulnerable children will not receive the medical care they need and their families may be forced into the kind of impossible decisions that result in more children being trafficked and exploited for profit. For God's children, Eduardo Verastegui Sound of Freedom, Producer For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

Friends,
What the Trump administration is doing in Minnesota is against the law.
No matter what Donald Trump and Kristi Noem try to tell the American people, ICE does not have free rein to violate the law, attack peaceful protesters, and systematically conduct unconstitutional stops and arrests.
I’ve filed a new amicus brief to demand the end of these deliberately aggressive and unlawful immigration enforcement practices.

Their tactics blatantly disregard policing norms, Minnesota’s state sovereignty, and the sanctity of human life .
Trump himself has said that Minnesota is just the beginning — if left unchecked, he will no doubt threaten the safety, autonomy, and well-being of more states and communities.

| | This month, the Corporation for Public Broadcasting (CPB) voted to shut itself down. Here is an excerpt from their press release: _"CPB's Board determined that without the resources to fulfill its congressionally mandated responsibilities, maintaining the corporation as a nonfunctional entity would not serve the public interest or advance the goals of public media._ _A dormant and defunded CPB could have become vulnerable to future political manipulation or misuse, threatening the independence of public media and the trust audiences place in it, and potentially subjecting staff and board members to legal exposure from bad-faith actors."_ Trump's attacks on public media and its funding have consequences, and it is saddening to hear that CPB is choosing to close its doors. CPB has been responsible for funding public media like NPR and PBS, and it will be a devastating loss for Northwest Washington if we lose these programs as well. PBS is not just television. It is a public service. **For decades, PBS has offered fact-based journalism, lifelong learning, children's programming like Sesame Street, and award-winning documentaries that bring history, science, and culture into homes across America.** It reaches over 120 million people every month, and for many, it is their only source of non-commercial, accessible media. Defunding PBS will:
* Cut off educational programming for millions of children
* Undermine trusted journalism and local reporting
* Silence diverse and underrepresented voices
* Hit rural communities and small stations the hardest

Friends,
Texas is preparing for Winter Storm Fern, which is scheduled to move across Texas from Friday evening, January 23rd, through Wednesday, January 28th.
Everyone is encouraged to follow these simple steps now before the freezing weather arrives:
* **Protect pipes:** Insulate exposed pipes and allow faucets to drip during freezing temperatures to help prevent pipes from bursting.

* **Use heating sources safely:** Use space heaters and fireplaces with caution, keep them away from flammable materials, and never leave them unattended.

* **Be fire-ready:** Keep a working fire extinguisher on hand and make sure everyone in the home knows how to use it.

* **Know your shutoff valves:** Learn how to shut off water valves in case a pipe bursts.

* **Make an emergency kit:** Prepare a kit that includes flashlights, batteries, blankets, water, medications, and nonperishable food.

Please remember you can contact the HD15 State office at 512-463-0797.

Everyone is encouraged to follow these simple steps now before the freezing weather arrives: Protect pipes: Insulate exposed pipes and allow faucets to drip during freezing temperatures to help prevent pipes from bursting. Use heating sources safely: Use space heaters and fireplaces with caution, keep them away from flammable materials, and never leave them unattended. Be fire-ready: Keep a working fire extinguisher on hand and make sure everyone in the home knows how to use it. Know your shutoff valves: Learn how to shut off water valves in case a pipe bursts. Make an emergency kit:** Prepare a kit that includes flashlights, batteries, blankets, water, medications, and nonperishable food. In Pennsylvania, Democrats have just a one-seat majority in the state House of Representatives, and Republicans control the state Senate. It's unlikely the Democrats can retake the state Senate in 2026 (based on the maps), but we can grow our House majority. This would strengthen Governor Shapiro's hand and allow him to protect Pennsylvania from some of the worst moves by the Trump administration.
Achieving our objective may come down to one state House race in the suburbs of Pittsburgh, where Hadley Haas is running a strong campaign against an incumbent. In this video, we talk about the race, Hadley's background, the dynamics that make this such a great campaign to invest in, and her opponent's recent comment suggesting that the removal of information about slavery from a National Park site was good, so that we can "focus on the positive." It's definitely worth watching and you can support Hadley directly [here](https://substack.com/redirect/c50b2086-74b4-4ac1-a0e5-898d6ed6acee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Why Congress keeps pressing NIH over bat research funding tied to CSU
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado leaders are facing the fallout of years of policy decisions as a budget crisis deepens. Lawmakers [acknowledged shared responsibility](https://link.email.joinrmv.) as Medicaid costs surge and obligations outpace revenue. But when experts said “fully funding” education would [increase spending by 30 to 70 percent](https://link.email.joinrmv.), Democrats blamed TABOR for not being able to. Public safety concerns grew after a [budget panel declined to fund prison expansion](https://link.email.joinrmv.) despite warnings beds could run out by 2026. Federal pressure [paused wolf reintroductions](https://link.email.joinrmv.), while two major investigations highlighted accountability failures—an [$873 million medical device fraud case](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and renewed congressional scrutiny of [NIH-funded bat research tied to CSU](https://link.email.joinrmv.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Nationally, Republicans pushed the SAVE Act to [require proof of citizenship to vote](https://link.email.joinrmv.), framing it as a necessary step to restore election confidence ahead of 2026. Meanwhile, critics pointed to Virginia Democrats advancing tax hikes and regulations that [undercut their past affordability promises](https://link.email.joinrmv.), reinforcing conservative warnings about progressive governance.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** A Rocky Mountain Voice Editorial Board piece argues protests over a [proposed ICE detention center in Hudson](https://link.email.joinrmv.) expose liberal hypocrisy, noting the site previously operated as a prison without overwhelming the town. The piece contrasts activist claims with data showing Denver-area taxpayers have absorbed hundreds of millions in migrant-related costs, concluding that ideology—not facts—is driving opposition to enforcement as voters demand accountability and relief.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, January 23, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Why Congress keeps pressing NIH over bat research funding tied to CSU](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Congress is demanding more transparency from the NIH over bat research grants tied to Colorado State University, asking, “How many millions of tax dollars is NIH giving to live bat research and why?”
In a Jan. 12, 2026 letter to NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya, Sen. Joni Ernst and Rep. Paul Gosar called on the agency to cancel remaining funding tied to CSU bat research and to produce a full accounting of NIH-funded bat research dating back to 2017.
It was the second time in less than a year that Congress stepped in, giving NIH until Feb. 28 to respond.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[Protests over ICE center in Hudson reveal liberal hypocrisy](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Protest claims collapse under basic math:** Activists warned a proposed 1,200-bed ICE detention center would “double” Hudson’s population overnight, but the facility previously operated at similar capacity without transforming the town, exposing fear-based rhetoric untethered from reality.
* **Taxpayers already absorbed massive migrant costs:** Denver-area governments spent an estimated $356 million responding to the migrant surge, with schools, hospitals, and city budgets carrying the burden—undercutting claims that enforcement, not illegal immigration, harms communities.
* **Contracts contradict activist narratives:** FOIA-released ICE contracts show strict standards for medical care, food, transportation, and oversight, while redactions were tied to officer safety amid a 1,300% increase in assaults on ICE agents—not secrecy or abuse.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Federal Pressure Forces Colorado To Halt Wolf Reintroductions](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Federal intervention halts state overreach:** Colorado Parks and Wildlife announced it will pause wolf reintroductions for the 2026 winter season after mounting pressure from the Trump administration and the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service over mismanagement of the program.
* **Mismanagement triggered loss of trust:** Colorado was rejected by Washington state for additional wolf transfers, faced criticism from Washington residents, and saw the resignation of CPW Director Jeff Davis amid growing concerns about accountability and competence.
* **Feds demanded transparency—or else:** U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service warned Colorado to provide a full accounting of wolf management activities dating back to December 2023 or risk losing its authority to manage wolves altogether, underscoring how rushed policy can invite federal takeover.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**How Colorado’s caucus system works—and why the 2026 midterm elections start now**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 21** _If you’ve ever heard the word “caucus” and quietly thought, I’m not entirely sure what that actually means, you’re not alone. Even Eric Trump has admitted he had to ask. While campaigning for his father during the 2016 election, he recalls turning to organizers and asking, “Can someone finally explain what this caucus is?”_ __
[**Merit Academy: Undeniable Change, A Model For Our Next Victory**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY ERIC GIL | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 21** _The success of Merit Academy in Woodland Park is no secret. When your school is ranked #5 of all K-12 Colorado Public Schools, it is hard to hide. This article is a look into the origin story of Merit Academy, led by Headmaster Gwynne Pekron. A reminder that we still hold the power to shape our children’s futures and that even when faced with centralized control, a path to real change exists._
____
__[**A new session, same defiance: How Colorado’s immigration policy put ideology over enforcement**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 20** _Colorado lawmakers are walking into the 2026 session with the budget already tight. They’re also bracing for more legal fights with Washington. New bills tied to ICE enforcement are moving early, including one that would expand the state’s ability to sue over immigration-related rights claims._[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)__

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: The Christian response to drag queen story hour
body:
| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e23830089/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvTXRrRTRxczNERw/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAxMjM/LbmNsTWxyU0c4UQ/qP2hpZHM9bmNHTGRTRHJSU0JLeHZscw/gaXQCvw/sbg64bbdec8)
| | If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
| | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, _**[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series. And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An _ABC_ _board_ _book_ for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby_. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...
---
| | [ ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| ...but that’s just not true. <\- THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.”
---
| | _**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family -- for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) **_ My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own. And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours” filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. _**[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming. That’s a very good thing. But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. _**[That’s why I’ve teamed with a very special non-profit called BRAVE for Good to make this year’s “See You at the Library Day” a bigger success than ever.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ **BRAVE for Good** was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift. Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. _**[Knowing that, please consider a sponsorship gift of $125. That’s enough to sponsor one entire ‘Story Hour Kit’ yourself.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**_ Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $125, or anything higher or lower please send in your sponsorship gift in the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we have sponsored for this year’s “See You at the Library Day.”
---
[ **DONATE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Kirk Cameron
---
|
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**BRAVE For Good** 100 I-45 N 260 Conroe, TX 77301
---

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I’m suing Pete Hegseth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maggie for NH
body:
Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to silence me because they don’t like what I have to say.

Team, it's Mark.

**I am suing the Secretary of Defense.**

After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like this. Hegseth has left me no choice.

Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth want to use the power of the White House and the Department of Defense to punish me because they don’t like what I have to say. Their attacks are directed at me right now, but they’re trying to send a message to every retired member of the military:

Speak out against us and we will come after you with every tool we have at our disposal. We’ll censure you, we’ll threaten your rank and retirement, and we might even court-martial you.

It’s unconstitutional, so I’m suing them. Beyond this lawsuit, it’s important we send a message to Trump and Hegseth to show them just how many people are on this team to defend constitutional rights. That’s where you come in.

I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do.

MONTGOMERY, Ala. (WBMA) — U.S. Senator Katie Britt applauded the unanimous decision by the U.S. House of Representatives Committee on Energy and Commerce to advance Lulu’s Law to the House floor.

The bipartisan legislation, named after 16-year-old Lulu Gribbin who survived a near-fatal shark attack in June 2024, aims to allow shark attacks to be included in wireless emergency alerts.

DOTHAN, Ala. (WTVY) - U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Alabama) announced Wednesday that through the recent passage of two 2026 fiscal year appropriations bills, she was able to secure over $2 million dollars in federal funding for the Wiregrass region.

Britt, a member of the Senate Committee on Appropriations, was able to bring in some much needed money for five separate law enforcement and community facility projects and programs in the area, which are part of two pieces of funding legislation: the FY26 Commerce, Justice, Science, and Related Agencies (CIS) Appropriations Act and the FY26 Energy and Water Development and Related Agencies (EWD) Appropriations Act.
